lemma sum_sum_eq_sum_Un:
  fixes A :: "nat \<Rightarrow> nat set"
  assumes "\<forall>x \<in> {1..m}. \<forall>y \<in> {1..m}. x \<noteq> y \<longrightarrow> A x \<inter> A y = {}"
      and "\<forall>x \<in> {1..m}. finite (A x)"

trg:
using assms
proof (induction m)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  have "(\<Sum>x \<in> {1..Suc m}. (\<Sum>y \<in> A x. t y)) = (\<Sum>x \<in> {1..m}. (\<Sum>y \<in> A x. t y)) + (\<Sum>y \<in> A (Suc m). t y)"
    by (simp add: sum.atLeast_Suc_atMost)
  also have "... = (\<Sum>x \<in> (\<Union>y \<in> {1..m}. A y). t x) + (\<Sum>y \<in> A (Suc m). t y)"
    using Suc by simp
  also have "... = (\<Sum>x \<in> (\<Union>y \<in> {1..m}. A y) \<union> A (Suc m). t x)"
    by (simp add: sum.union_disjoint)
  also have "... = (\<Sum>x \<in> (\<Union>y \<in> {1..Suc m}. A y). t x)"
    by (simp add: SUP_le_iff)
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma sum_card:
  fixes U :: "'a set set"
    and n :: nat
  assumes "\<forall>S \<in> U. card S \<le> n"
  shows "sum card U \<le> card U * n"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction U)
  case empty
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (insert S U)
  have "sum card (insert S U) = card S + sum card U"
    by simp
  also have "... \<le> card S + card U * n"
    using insert.IH insert.prems by auto
  also have "... \<le> card (insert S U) * n"
    using card_insert_le_m1[of S U] by (simp add: mult_right_mono)
  finally show ?case .
qed

proof (prove)

  assume eq: "equiv_trans t u"
     and sd: "sub_distrib t"

  also have "... = t f s + t g s"
    using sd unfolding sub_distrib_def by auto

lemma finite_set_least:
  fixes S::"'a::linorder set"
  assumes finite: "finite S"
      and ne: "S \<noteq> {}"
  shows "\<exists>x\<in>S. \<forall>y\<in>S. x \<le> y"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction rule: finite_induct)
  case empty
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (insert x S)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "S = {}")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then obtain y where "y \<in> S" by blast
    then have "x \<le> y \<or> y \<le> x" by (metis insert.hyps insert.prems le_cases)

lemma lfp_loop_fp:
  assumes hb: "healthy (wp body)"
      and sP: "sound P"
  shows "\<lambda>s. \<guillemotleft>G\<guillemotright> s * wp body (\<lambda>s. bound_of P) s + \<guillemotleft>\<N> G\<guillemotright> s * P s \<tturnstile> \<lambda>s. bound_of P"
trg:
using hb sP
proof (prove)
  have "sound (\<lambda>s. \<guillemotleft>G\<guillemotright> s * wp body (\<lambda>s. bound_of P) s + \<guillemotleft>\<N> G\<guillemotright> s * P s)"
    by (rule sound_intros)
  also have "(\<lambda>s. \<guillemotleft>G\<guillemotright> s * wp body (\<lambda>s. bound_of P) s + \<guillemotleft>\<N> G\<guillemotright> s * P s) \<tturnstile> (\<lambda>s. bound_of P)"
  proof (rule lfp_induct_step)
    show "sound (\<lambda>s. bound_of P)"
      by (rule sP)
  next
    show "healthy (wp body)"
      by (rule hb)
  next
    show "(\<lambda>s. \<guillemotleft>G\<guillemotright> s * wp body (\<lambda>s. bound_of P) s + \<guillemotleft>\<N> G\<guillemotright> s * P s) \<tturnstile> (\<lambda>s. wp body (\<lambda>s. bound_of P) s)"
      by (rule wp_loop_step)
  qed
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma loop_induct:
  fixes body::"'s prog"
  assumes hwp:  "healthy (wp body)"
      and hwlp: "nearly_healthy (wlp body)"
      \<comment> \<open>The body must be healthy, both in strict and liberal semantics.\<close>
      and Limit:   "\<And>S. \<lbrakk> \<forall>x\<in>S. P (fst x) (snd x); \<forall>x\<in>S. feasible (fst x);
                          \<forall>x\<in>S. \<forall>Q. unitary Q \<longrightarrow> unitary (snd x Q) \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
                    P (Sup_trans (fst ` S)) (Inf_utrans (snd ` S))"
      \<comment> \<open>The property holds at limit points.\<close>
      and IH:   "\<And>t u. \<lbrakk> P t u; feasible t; \<And>Q. unitary Q \<Longrightarrow> unitary (u Q)  \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
                        P (wp  (body ;; Embed t \<^bsub>\<guillemotleft> G \<guillemotright>\<^esub>\<oplus> Skip))
                          (wlp (body ;; Embed u \<^bsub>\<guillemotleft> G \<guillemotright>\<^esub>\<oplus> Skip))"
      \<comment> \<open>The inductive step.  The property is preserved by a single loop iteration.\<close>
      and P_equiv: "\<And>t t' u u'. \<lbrakk> P t u; equiv_trans t t'; equiv_utrans u u' \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> P t' u'"
      \<comment> \<open>The property must be preserved by equivalence\<close>
  shows "P (wp (do G \<longrightarrow> body od)) (wlp (do G \<longrightarrow> body od))"
  \<comment> \<open>The property can refer to both interpretations simultaneously.  The unifier will happily
  apply the rule to just one or the other, however.\<close>
trg:
proof (prove)
  using assms
  by (rule loop_induct_aux)

end

lemma loop_term_nat_measure_noinv:
  fixes m :: "'s \<Rightarrow> nat" and body :: "'s prog"
  assumes wb: "well_def body"
  and guard: "\<And>s. m s = 0 \<longrightarrow> \<not> G s"
  and variant: "\<And>n. \<guillemotleft>\<lambda>s. m s = Suc n\<guillemotright> \<tturnstile> wp body \<guillemotleft>\<lambda>s. m s = n\<guillemotright>"
  shows "\<lambda>s. 1 \<tturnstile> wp do G \<longrightarrow> body od (\<lambda>s. 1)"

lemma loop_term_nat_measure:
  fixes m :: "'s \<Rightarrow> nat" and body :: "'s prog"
  assumes wb:  "well_def body"
  and guard:   "\<And>s. m s = 0 \<longrightarrow> \<not> G s"
  and variant: "\<And>n. \<guillemotleft>\<lambda>s. m s = Suc n\<guillemotright> && \<guillemotleft>I\<guillemotright> \<tturnstile> wp body \<guillemotleft>\<lambda>s. m s = n\<guillemotright>"
  and inv:     "wp_inv G body \<guillemotleft>I\<guillemotright>"
  shows "\<guillemotleft>I\<guillemotright> \<tturnstile> wp do G \<longrightarrow> body od (\<lambda>s. 1)"
trg:
proof (prove)
  using assms
  by (rule loop_term_nat_measure_aux)

end

   pcorres \<phi> G A B"

      and wA: "well_def A"

  shows "pcorres \<phi> G A B"
trg: by (auto simp: pcorres_def withG wA wB)

  "wp (a \<Sqinter> b) P = (\<lambda>s. min (wp a P s) (wp b P s))"

  "wlp (a \<Sqinter> b) P = (\<lambda>s. min (wlp a P s) (wlp b P s))"

  "wp (a \<Squnion> b) P = (\<lambda>s. max (wp a P s) (wp b P s))"

lemma eval_wlp_AC:
  "wlp (a \<Squnion> b) P = (\<lambda>s. max (wlp a P s) (wlp b P s))"

  "wlp (SetPC f p) P = (\<lambda>s. \<Sum>a\<in>supp (p s). p s a * wlp (f a) P s)"

lemma plays_from_strategy_remains_const:
  assumes "n \<le> i"
  shows "take n (strategy_progression \<sigma> p  $  i)  =  strategy_progression \<sigma> p  $  n"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction i)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  have "take n (strategy_progression \<sigma> p $ Suc i) = take n (strategy_progression \<sigma> p $ i) @ [\<sigma> p (strategy_progression \<sigma> p $ i)]"
    by (simp add: strategy_progression_def)
  also have "\<dots> = strategy_progression \<sigma> p $ n"
  proof (cases "n \<le> i")
    case True
    then have "take n (strategy_progression \<sigma> p $ i) = strategy_progression \<sigma> p $ n"
      using Suc.IH by blast
    then show ?thesis
      by (simp add: strategy_progression_def)
  next
    case False
    then have "n = Suc i"
      using assms by auto
    then show ?thesis
      by (simp add: strategy_progression_def)
  qed
  finally show ?case .
qed

end

lemma infplays_eq:
  assumes "\<And> p'. prefix p p' \<Longrightarrow> augment_list s1 p' = augment_list s2 p'"
  shows "strategy_progression s1 p = strategy_progression s2 p"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction p)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a p)
  have "strategy_progression s1 (a # p) = strategy_progression s1 p"
    by (simp add: strategy_progression_def)
  also have "... = strategy_progression s2 p"
    using Cons.IH by simp
  also have "... = strategy_progression s2 (a # p)"
    by (simp add: strategy_progression_def)
  finally show ?case by simp
qed

end

lemma every_position_is_determined:
  assumes "position p"
  shows "winning_position_Even p \<or> winning_position_Odd p" (is "?we \<or> ?wo")
trg:
using assms
proof (induction p rule: position.induct)
  case (position_Nil)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (position_Cons a p)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases a)
    case (Even a')
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "p = []")
      case True
      then show ?thesis
        using Even by simp
    next
      case False
      then show ?thesis
        using position_Cons.IH Even by simp
    qed
  next
    case (Odd a')
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "p = []")
      case True
      then show ?thesis
        using Odd by simp
    next
      case False
      then show ?thesis
        using position_Cons.IH Odd by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

end

  case Nil

    then show ?thesis using Suc by simp
  qed
qed

lemma foldr_refine:
  assumes "I s"
  assumes "\<And>s x. I s \<Longrightarrow> x\<in>set l \<Longrightarrow> I (f x s) \<and> \<alpha> (f x s) = f' x (\<alpha> s)"
  shows "I (foldr f l s) \<and> \<alpha> (foldr f l s) = foldr f' l (\<alpha> s)"
trg:

  case Nil

  case (Cons a l)

  then show ?case by simp
qed

lemma monad_fmap:
  fixes xs :: "'a\<cdot>'m::monad" and f :: "'a \<rightarrow> 'b"
  shows "fmap\<cdot>f\<cdot>xs = xs \<bind> (\<Lambda> x. return\<cdot>(f\<cdot>x))"
trg:
proof (prove)
  fix xs :: "'a\<cdot>'m::monad" and f :: "'a \<rightarrow> 'b"
  show "fmap\<cdot>f\<cdot>xs = xs \<bind> (\<Lambda> x. return\<cdot>(f\<cdot>x))"
  proof (induct xs)
    case bottom
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (return x)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (bind x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (fmap x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (join x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (fcomp x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_x x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_s x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_both x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_f x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_g x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_both_f x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_both_g x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_f_g x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_f_both x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_g_both x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  next
    case (let_f_g_both x s)
    show ?case by (simp add: fmap_def)
  qed
qed

lemma set_in_convex_hull_list: fixes Vs :: "'a vec list"
  assumes "set Vs \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
  shows "set Vs \<subseteq> convex_hull_list Vs"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction Vs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons v Vs)
  have "set (v # Vs) \<subseteq> carrier_vec n" by fact
  then have "v \<in> carrier_vec n" and "set Vs \<subseteq> carrier_vec n" by auto
  have "set Vs \<subseteq> convex_hull_list Vs" by (rule Cons.IH)
  then have "convex_hull_list Vs \<subseteq> convex_hull_list (v # Vs)"
    by (rule convex_hull_list_mono)
  with \<open>v \<in> carrier_vec n\<close> have "convex_hull_list (v # Vs) = convex_hull_list Vs \<union> {v}"
    by (rule convex_hull_list_insert)
  with \<open>set Vs \<subseteq> convex_hull_list Vs\<close> show ?case by auto
qed

end

lemma convex_hull_list_combination:
  assumes Vs: "set Vs \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
    and x: "x \<in> convex_hull_list Vs"
    and y: "y \<in> convex_hull_list Vs"
    and l0: "0 \<le> l" and l1: "l \<le> 1"
  shows "l \<cdot>\<^sub>v x + (1 - l) \<cdot>\<^sub>v y \<in> convex_hull_list Vs"
trg:
using Vs x y l0 l1
proof (induction Vs arbitrary: x y l)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons v Vs)
  have "set (v # Vs) \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
    using Cons.prems by auto
  then have "v \<in> carrier_vec n" and "set Vs \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
    by auto
  show ?case
  proof (cases "l = 0")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      using Cons.prems by auto
  next
    case False
    then have "0 < l"
      using l0 by auto
    then have "l = 1 - (1 - l)"
      by auto
    then have "l \<cdot>\<^sub>v x + (1 - l) \<cdot>\<^sub>v y = (1 - l) \<cdot>\<^sub>v y + l \<cdot>\<^sub>v x"
      by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using Cons.prems by auto
  qed
qed

end

trg:

lemma add_0_right_vecset:
  assumes "(A :: 'a :: monoid_add vec set) \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
  shows "A + {0\<^sub>v n} = A"
trg:
using assms
proof (rule subset_antisym)
  show "A + {0\<^sub>v n} \<subseteq> A"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix v assume "v \<in> A + {0\<^sub>v n}"
    then obtain a b where "a \<in> A" "b \<in> {0\<^sub>v n}" "v = a + b"
      unfolding set_plus_def by auto
    with assms show "v \<in> A" by auto
  qed
  show "A \<subseteq> A + {0\<^sub>v n}"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix v assume "v \<in> A"
    with assms have "v \<in> carrier_vec n" by auto
    hence "v = v + 0\<^sub>v n" by auto
    with `v \<in> A` show "v \<in> A + {0\<^sub>v n}" unfolding set_plus_def by auto
  qed
qed

end

lemma exists_lin_indpt_sublist: assumes X: "X \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
  shows "\<exists> Ls. lin_indpt_list Ls \<and> span (set Ls) = span X \<and> set Ls \<subseteq> X"
trg:
using X
proof (induction "card X" arbitrary: X rule: less_induct)
  case less
  show ?case
  proof (cases "X = {}")
    case True
    then show ?thesis using lin_indpt_list.Nil by auto
  next
    case False
    then obtain x where x: "x \<in> X" by auto
    define Y where "Y = X - {x}"
    have "card Y < card X" using x by (auto simp: Y_def)
    have "Y \<subseteq> carrier_vec n" using less.prems by (auto simp: Y_def)
    from less.hyps[OF \<open>card Y < card X\<close> \<open>Y \<subseteq> carrier_vec n\<close>]
    obtain Ls where Ls: "lin_indpt_list Ls" "span (set Ls) = span Y" "set Ls \<subseteq> Y" by auto
    have "x \<notin> set Ls" using Ls(3) by (auto simp: Y_def)
    have "lin_indpt_list (Ls @ [x])"
      by (rule lin_indpt_list_appendI[OF Ls(1) _ _ x], insert Ls(3), auto)
    moreover have "span (set (Ls @ [x])) = span X"
      by (rule span_eqI[OF _ Ls(2)], auto simp: Y_def)
    moreover have "set (Ls @ [x]) \<subseteq> X" using Ls(3) by (auto simp: Y_def)
    ultimately show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed

end

lemma decomposition_theorem_polyhedra:
  "(\<exists> A b nr. A \<in> carrier_mat nr n \<and> b \<in> carrier_vec nr \<and> P = polyhedron A b) \<longleftrightarrow>
   (\<exists> Q X. Q \<union> X \<subseteq> carrier_vec n \<and> finite (Q \<union> X) \<and> P = convex_hull Q + cone X)" (is "?l = ?r")

lemma polytope_equiv_bounded_polyhedron:
  "polytope P \<longleftrightarrow>
  (\<exists>A b nr bnd. A \<in> carrier_mat nr n \<and> b \<in> carrier_vec nr \<and> P = polyhedron A b \<and> P \<subseteq> Bounded_vec bnd)"

lemma span_diff: assumes A: "A \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
  and a: "a \<in> span A" and b: "b \<in> span A"
shows "a - b \<in> span A"
trg:
using a b
proof (induct rule: span_induct)
  case (span_base a)
  then show ?case
    by (metis (no_types) A a b span_diff_closed)
next
  case (span_step a)
  then show ?case
    by (metis (no_types) A a b span_diff_closed)
qed
end

lemma lincomb_scalar_prod_right: assumes "W \<subseteq> carrier_vec n" "v \<in> carrier_vec n"
  shows "v \<bullet> lincomb a W = (\<Sum>w\<in>W. a w * (v \<bullet> w))"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction W)
  case (insert w W)
  then have "v \<bullet> lincomb a (insert w W) = v \<bullet> (a w \<cdot>\<^sub>v w + lincomb a W)"
    by (simp add: lincomb_insert)
  also have "... = a w * (v \<bullet> w) + v \<bullet> lincomb a W"
    using assms by (simp add: scalar_prod_add_distrib)
  also have "... = a w * (v \<bullet> w) + (\<Sum>w\<in>W. a w * (v \<bullet> w))"
    using insert by simp
  also have "... = (\<Sum>w\<in>insert w W. a w * (v \<bullet> w))"
    using insert by (simp add: sum.insert)
  finally show ?case .
qed simp

end

  and X: "X \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
  and ortho: "\<And> w x. w \<in> W \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> X \<Longrightarrow> w \<bullet> x = 0"
  and w: "w \<in> span W" and x: "x \<in> span X"
shows "w \<bullet> x = 0"
trg:
using W X ortho w x
proof (induction rule: span_induct_alt)
  case (base v)
  then have "v \<in> X" by (metis span_base)
  then show ?case by (metis ortho base)
next
  case (step v)
  then have "v \<in> W" by (metis span_step)
  then show ?case by (metis ortho step)
next
  case (span v)
  then have "v \<in> W" by (metis span_span)
  then show ?case by (metis ortho span)
qed

end

lemma bounded_vecset_sum:
  assumes Acarr: "A \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
    and Bcarr: "B \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
    and sum: "C = A + B"
    and Cbnd: "\<exists> bndC. C \<subseteq> Bounded_vec bndC"
  shows "A \<noteq> {} \<Longrightarrow> (\<exists> bndB. B \<subseteq> Bounded_vec bndB)"
    and "B \<noteq> {} \<Longrightarrow> (\<exists> bndA. A \<subseteq> Bounded_vec bndA)"
trg:
using Acarr Bcarr sum Cbnd
proof (prove)
  assume Acarr: "A \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
    and Bcarr: "B \<subseteq> carrier_vec n"
    and sum: "C = A + B"
    and Cbnd: "\<exists> bndC. C \<subseteq> Bounded_vec bndC"
  show "A \<noteq> {} \<Longrightarrow> (\<exists> bndB. B \<subseteq> Bounded_vec bndB)"
    and "B \<noteq> {} \<Longrightarrow> (\<exists> bndA. A \<subseteq> Bounded_vec bndA)"
  proof (cases "A = {}")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then obtain a where a: "a \<in> A" by auto
    have "B = C - A" using sum by (auto simp add: set_plus_def)
    then have "B = (\<lambda> b. a + b) ` (C - a)" by (auto simp add: image_def)
    then have "B = (\<lambda> b. a + b) ` (Bounded_vec bndC - a)" using Cbnd by auto
    then have "B \<subseteq> Bounded_vec (bndC + norm a)" using Bcarr a
      by (auto simp add: Bounded_vec_def intro!: exI[of _ "bndC + norm a"])
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case False
    then obtain b where b: "b \<in> B" by auto
    have "A = C - B" using sum by (auto simp add: set_plus_def)
    then have "A = (\<lambda> a. a - b) ` (C - b)" by (auto simp add: image_def)
    then have "A = (\<lambda> a. a - b) ` (Bounded_vec bndC - b)" using Cbnd by auto
    then have "A \<subseteq> Bounded_vec (bndC + norm b)" using Acarr b
      by (auto simp add: Bounded_vec_def intro!: exI[of _ "bndC + norm b"])
    then show ?thesis by auto
  qed
qed
end

theorem decomposition_theorem_integer_hull_of_polyhedron: assumes A: "A \<in> carrier_mat nr n"
  and b: "b \<in> carrier_vec nr"
  and AI: "A \<in> \<int>\<^sub>m"
  and bI: "b \<in> \<int>\<^sub>v"
  and P: "P = polyhedron A b"
  and Bnd: "Bnd = Max (abs ` (elements_mat A \<union> vec_set b))"
shows "\<exists> H C. H \<union> C \<subseteq> carrier_vec n \<inter> \<int>\<^sub>v 
  \<and> H \<subseteq> Bounded_vec (fact (n+1) * (max 1 Bnd)^n)
  \<and> C \<subseteq> Bounded_vec (fact n * (max 1 Bnd)^n)
  \<and> finite (H \<union> C) 
  \<and> integer_hull P = convex_hull H + cone C"

using this:
A \<in> carrier_mat nr n
b \<in> carrier_vec nr
A \<in> \<int>\<^sub>m
b \<in> \<int>\<^sub>v
P = polyhedron A b
Bnd = Max (abs ` (elements_mat A \<union> vec_set b))

goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<exists>H C. H \<union> C \<subseteq> carrier_vec n \<inter> \<int>\<^sub>v \<and> H \<subseteq> Bounded_vec (fact (n + 1) * (max 1 Bnd) ^ n) \<and> C \<subseteq> Bounded_vec (fact n * (max 1 Bnd) ^ n) \<and> finite (H \<union> C) \<and> integer_hull P = convex_hull H + cone C

lemma exec_wfs_no_error:
  "wfs \<Gamma> s \<Longrightarrow> match \<sigma> \<Gamma> \<Longrightarrow> \<not> (s \<rhd> \<sigma> \<leadsto> None)"

lemma exec_wfs_always_match:
  "wfs \<Gamma> s \<Longrightarrow> match \<sigma> \<Gamma> \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>\<sigma>'. s \<rhd> \<sigma> \<leadsto> Some \<sigma>' \<and> match \<sigma>' \<Gamma>"

lemma exec_wfp_no_error:
  "wfp p \<Longrightarrow> \<sigma> \<in> states p \<Longrightarrow> \<not> (body p \<rhd> \<sigma> \<leadsto> None)"

lemma exec_wfp_in_states:
  "wfp p \<Longrightarrow> \<sigma> \<in> states p \<Longrightarrow> body p \<rhd> \<sigma> \<leadsto> Some \<sigma>' \<Longrightarrow> \<sigma>' \<in> states p"

lemma exec_wfp_always_in_states:
  "wfp p \<Longrightarrow> \<sigma> \<in> states p \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>\<sigma>'. body p \<rhd> \<sigma> \<leadsto> Some \<sigma>' \<and> \<sigma>' \<in> states p"

lemma spec\<^sub>0_GNI:
  "spec\<^sub>0 p \<Longrightarrow> GNI (traces p)"

  "vars p = vars\<^sub>0 \<Longrightarrow> io_vars p"

lemma reduce_wf_prog_to_body:
  "vars p = vars\<^sub>0 \<Longrightarrow> wfp p \<longleftrightarrow> wfs \<Gamma>\<^sub>0 (body p)"

lemma low_proc_non0\<^sub>1_correct:
  "vars p = vars\<^sub>0 \<Longrightarrow> low_proc_non0\<^sub>1 p \<longleftrightarrow> low_proc_non0 p"

lemma low_proc_0\<^sub>1_correct:
  "vars p = vars\<^sub>0 \<Longrightarrow> low_proc_0\<^sub>1 p \<longleftrightarrow> low_proc_0 p"

lemma high_proc\<^sub>1_correct:
  "vars p = vars\<^sub>0 \<Longrightarrow> high_proc\<^sub>1 p \<longleftrightarrow> high_proc p"

lemma step_1_correct:
  "spec\<^sub>1 p \<Longrightarrow> spec\<^sub>0 p"

lemma reduce_wf_body_to_stmts:
  "body_split p s\<^sub>L s\<^sub>H \<Longrightarrow> wfs \<Gamma>\<^sub>0 (body p) \<longleftrightarrow> wfs \<Gamma>\<^sub>0 s\<^sub>L \<and> wfs \<Gamma>\<^sub>0 s\<^sub>H"

lemma proc\<^sub>2_correct:
  assumes Body: "body_split p s\<^sub>L s\<^sub>H"
  assumes WfLow: "wfs \<Gamma>\<^sub>0 s\<^sub>L"
  assumes WfHigh: "wfs \<Gamma>\<^sub>0 s\<^sub>H"
  assumes LowNon0: "low_proc_non0\<^sub>2 s\<^sub>L"
  assumes Low0: "low_proc_0\<^sub>2 s\<^sub>L"
  assumes LowSame: "low_proc_no_input_change s\<^sub>L"
  assumes High: "high_proc\<^sub>2 s\<^sub>H"
  assumes HighSame: "high_proc_no_low_output_change s\<^sub>H"
  shows "low_proc_non0\<^sub>1 p \<and> low_proc_0\<^sub>1 p \<and> high_proc\<^sub>1 p"
trg:
proof (prove)
  using assms
  by (auto simp: body_split_def low_proc_non0\<^sub>1_def low_proc_0\<^sub>1_def high_proc\<^sub>1_def)

end

lemma skip_elim [elim]:
  "\<langle>Skip, mds, mem\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<leadsto>\<^sub>w \<langle>c', mds', mem'\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<Longrightarrow> c' = Stop \<and> mds = mds' \<and> mem = mem'"

lemma assign_elim [elim]:
  "\<langle>x \<leftarrow> e, mds, mem\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<leadsto>\<^sub>w \<langle>c', mds', mem'\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<Longrightarrow> c' = Stop \<and> mds = mds' \<and> mem' = mem (x := eval\<^sub>A mem e)"

lemma while_elim [elim]:
  "\<lbrakk> \<langle>While e c, mds, mem\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<leadsto>\<^sub>w \<langle>c', mds', mem'\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> c' = If e (c ;; While e c) Stop \<and> mds' = mds \<and> mem' = mem"

lemma upd_elim [elim]:
  "\<langle>c@[upd], mds, mem\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<leadsto>\<^sub>w \<langle>c', mds', mem'\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<Longrightarrow> \<langle>c, update_modes upd mds, mem\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<leadsto>\<^sub>w \<langle>c', mds', mem'\<rangle>\<^sub>w"

lemma cxt_seq_elim [elim]:
  "c\<^sub>1 ;; c\<^sub>2 = cxt_to_stmt E c \<Longrightarrow> (E = [] \<and> c = c\<^sub>1 ;; c\<^sub>2) \<or> (\<exists> c' cs. E = c' # cs \<and> c = c\<^sub>1 \<and> c\<^sub>2 = cxt_to_stmt cs c')"
lemma stop_no_eval: "\<not> (\<langle>Stop, mds, mem\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<leadsto>\<^sub>w \<langle>c', mds', mem'\<rangle>\<^sub>w)"

lemma seq_stop_elim [elim]:
  "\<langle>Stop ;; c, mds, mem\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<leadsto>\<^sub>w \<langle>c', mds', mem'\<rangle>\<^sub>w \<Longrightarrow> c' = c \<and> mds' = mds \<and> mem' = mem"

lemma cxt_stmt_seq:
  "c ;; cxt_to_stmt E c' = cxt_to_stmt (c' # E) c"

lemma seq_elim [elim]:

proof -

  proof (rule exp_le_cancel_iff[THEN iffD1])
    have "exp (2/3) < exp (ln 2)"
      using exp_ln[of 2] by simp
    thus "exp (2/3) < 2"
      using exp_less_cancel_iff[of "2/3" "ln 2"] by simp
  qed
  thus "ln (2 :: real) \<ge> 2/3" by simp

  have "ln (2 :: real) \<le> 16/23"
  proof (rule exp_le_cancel_iff[THEN iffD1])
    have "exp (16/23) < exp (ln 2)"
      using exp_ln[of 2] by simp
    thus "exp (16/23) < 2"
      using exp_less_cancel_iff[of "16/23" "ln 2"] by simp
  qed
  thus "ln (2 :: real) \<le> 16/23" by simp
qed

lemma primepow_odd_altdef:

     primepow n \<and> odd (multiplicity (aprimedivisor n) n) \<and> multiplicity (aprimedivisor n) n > 1"

lemma primepow_even_altdef:
  "primepow_even n \<longleftrightarrow> primepow n \<and> even (multiplicity (aprimedivisor n) n)"

lemma primepow_odd_mult:
  assumes "d > Suc 0"
  shows   "primepow_odd (aprimedivisor d * d) \<longleftrightarrow> primepow_even d"
trg:
using prime_aprimedivisor[of d]
proof (cases "aprimedivisor d = 2")
  case True
  then show ?thesis
    using assms by (auto simp: primepow_odd_def primepow_even_def)
next
  case False
  have "prime (aprimedivisor d)"
    using prime_aprimedivisor[of d] by simp
  then have "aprimedivisor d > 2"
    using False by (auto simp: prime_def)
  then have "aprimedivisor d * d > 2 * d"
    using assms by (intro mult_strict_right_mono) auto
  then have "primepow_odd (aprimedivisor d * d) \<longleftrightarrow> primepow_odd (2 * d)"
    using prime_aprimedivisor[of d] by (intro primepow_odd_cong) auto
  also have "\<dots> \<longleftrightarrow> primepow_even d"
    using assms by (auto simp: primepow_odd_def primepow_even_def)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma pre_mangoldt_primepow:
  assumes "primepow n" "aprimedivisor n = p"
  shows   "pre_mangoldt n = p"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction n rule: primepow_induct)
  case (prime p)
  then show ?case
    by (simp add: pre_mangoldt_def)
next
  case (times p n)
  have "aprimedivisor (p * n) = min (aprimedivisor p) (aprimedivisor n)"
    by (rule aprimedivisor_times)
  also have "min (aprimedivisor p) (aprimedivisor n) = aprimedivisor p"
    using times.prems by (intro min_eqI) (auto simp: prime_aprimedivisor)
  finally have "aprimedivisor (p * n) = p" .
  with times.prems show ?case
    by (simp add: pre_mangoldt_def)
qed

end

lemma pre_mangoldt_notprimepow:
  assumes "\<not>primepow n"
  shows   "pre_mangoldt n = 1"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction n rule: primepow_induct)
  case (base p)
  then show ?case
    by (simp add: pre_mangoldt_def)
next
  case (step p k)
  have "pre_mangoldt (p ^ k) = 1"
    using step.IH[of "p ^ (k - 1)"] by (simp add: pre_mangoldt_def)
  also have "p ^ (k - 1) = p ^ k / p"
    using step.hyps by (simp add: prime_elem_power_divisor)
  finally show ?case
    by (simp add: pre_mangoldt_def)
qed

lemma div_2_mult_2_bds:
  fixes n d :: nat
  assumes "d > 0"
  shows "0 \<le> \<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> - 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor>" "\<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> - 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor> \<le> 1"
trg:
using assms
proof (prove)
  show "0 \<le> \<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> - 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor>"
  proof (cases "n mod 2 = 0")
    case True
    then have "n = 2 * (n div 2)" by simp
    then have "n / d = 2 * (n div 2) / d" by simp
    then have "\<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> = 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor>" by simp
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then have "n mod 2 = 1" by simp
    then have "n = 2 * (n div 2) + 1" by simp
    then have "n / d = 2 * (n div 2) / d + 1 / d" by simp
    then have "\<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> = 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor> + 1" by simp
    then have "\<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> - 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor> = 1" by simp
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed
next
  show "\<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> - 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor> \<le> 1"
  proof (cases "n mod 2 = 0")

    then have "\<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> = 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor>" by simp

    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False

    then have "n = 2 * (n div 2) + 1" by simp
    then have "n / d = 2 * (n div 2) / d + 1 / d" by simp
    then have "\<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> = 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor> + 1" by simp
    then have "\<lfloor>n / d\<rfloor> - 2 * \<lfloor>(n div 2) / d\<rfloor> = 1" by simp
    then show ?thesis by simp
  qed

lemma fact_psi_bound_even:
  assumes "even k"
  shows   "(\<Sum>d=1..k. (-1)^(d+1) * psi (n div d)) \<le> ln (fact n) - 2 * ln (fact (n div 2))"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction k rule: even_induct)
  case (even k)
  have "(\<Sum>d=1..k+2. (-1)^(d+1) * psi (n div d)) =
          (\<Sum>d=1..k. (-1)^(d+1) * psi (n div d)) +
          (-1)^(k+2) * psi (n div (k+2))"
    by (simp add: sum.atLeast_Suc_atMost)
  also have "... \<le> ln (fact n) - 2 * ln (fact (n div 2))"
  proof (cases "k = 0")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      by (simp add: sum.atLeast_Suc_atMost)
  next
    case False
    with even.prems have "k > 0"
      by (simp add: even_Suc)
    then have "k+2 = Suc (Suc k)"
      by simp
    also have "(\<Sum>d=1..k. (-1)^(d+1) * psi (n div d)) +
                 (-1)^(k+2) * psi (n div (k+2)) \<le>
                 ln (fact n) - 2 * ln (fact (n div 2))"
      using even.IH by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  finally show ?case .
qed
end

lemma fact_psi_bound_odd:
  assumes "odd k"
  shows "ln (fact n) - 2 * ln (fact (n div 2)) \<le> (\<Sum>d=1..k. (-1)^(d+1) * psi (n div d))"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction k rule: less_induct)
  case (less k)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "k = 1")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      by (simp add: psi_def)
  next
    case False
    then have "k > 1"
      by simp
    then have "k div 2 < k"
      by simp
    then have "odd (k div 2)"
      using odd_div_two_cases[of k] less.prems
      by (auto simp: odd_iff_mod_2_eq_one)
    have "ln (fact n) - 2 * ln (fact (n div 2)) = ln (fact n / (fact (n div 2) * fact (n div 2)))"
      by (simp add: ln_div)
    also have "fact n / (fact (n div 2) * fact (n div 2)) = (n choose (n div 2))"
      by (simp add: binomial_fact)
    also have "ln ... = psi n"
      by (simp add: psi_def)
    also have "... = psi (n div 1) + psi (n div 2)"
      by simp
    also have "... = psi (n div 1) - 2 * psi (n div 2)"
      by simp
    also have "... \<le> (\<Sum>d=1..1. (-1)^(d+1) * psi (n div d)) + (\<Sum>d=1..2. (-1)^(d+1) * psi (n div d))"
      by (intro add_mono less.IH) (use less.prems in auto)
    also have "... = (\<Sum>d=1..k. (-1)^(d+1) * psi (n div d))"
      using False by (simp add: sum.atLeast_Suc_atMost)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
qed

end

  case 2
  then show ?thesis by (metis Value_chain.simps(2) Value_chain_def)

  case 3
  then show ?thesis by (metis Value_chain.simps(3) Value_chain_def)
qed

     and "f m = f n"

  case Nil

  assumes "sorted_wrt R xs" "xs \<noteq> []" "x \<in> set xs" "x \<noteq> last xs"
  shows   "(x, last xs) \<in> R"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction xs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a xs)
  have "sorted_wrt R xs" "x \<in> set xs" "x \<noteq> last xs" using Cons.prems by auto
  then have "(x, last xs) \<in> R" using Cons.IH by auto
  then show ?case using Cons.prems by auto
qed

lemma sorted_wrt_append:
  assumes "sorted_wrt R xs" "sorted_wrt R ys" 
          "\<And>x y. x \<in> set xs \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> set ys \<Longrightarrow> (x,y) \<in> R" "trans R"
  shows   "sorted_wrt R (xs @ ys)"
trg:
using assms(1,2,4)
proof (induction xs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a xs)
  then have "sorted_wrt R (a # xs)" by simp
  moreover have "sorted_wrt R ys" by fact
  moreover have "trans R" by fact
  moreover have "a \<in> set (a # xs)" by simp
  moreover have "y \<in> set ys" for y by fact
  ultimately have "(a, y) \<in> R" by (rule transD[OF assms(4)])
  then have "sorted_wrt R (a # ys)" using Cons.IH by simp
  then show ?case by simp
qed

end

lemma sorted_wrt_linorder_imp_index_le:
  assumes "linorder_on A R" "set xs \<subseteq> A" "sorted_wrt R xs" 
          "x \<in> set xs" "y \<in> set xs" "(x,y) \<in> R"
  shows   "index xs x \<le> index xs y"
trg:
using assms(1,2,3,5)
proof (induction xs rule: list.induct)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a xs)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases "x = a")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "y = a")
      case True
      then show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case False
      then have "y \<in> set xs" using Cons.prems(4) by auto
      then have "index xs y = index (a # xs) y + 1" by simp
      also have "... \<le> index (a # xs) x" using Cons.IH[OF assms(1,2,3) Cons.prems(4) `y \<in> set xs`] by simp
      also have "... = index (a # xs) x + 1" using True by simp
      finally show ?thesis by simp
    qed
  next
    case False
    then have "x \<in> set xs" using Cons.prems(4) by auto
    then have "index xs x = index (a # xs) x" by simp
    also have "... \<le> index (a # xs) y" using Cons.IH[OF assms(1,2,3) `x \<in> set xs` Cons.prems(5)] by simp
    finally show ?thesis by simp
  qed
qed

lemma sorted_wrt_linorder_index_less_iff:
  assumes "linorder_on A R" "set xs \<subseteq> A" "sorted_wrt R xs" 
          "x \<in> set xs" "y \<in> set xs"
  shows   "index xs x < index xs y \<longleftrightarrow> (y,x) \<notin> R"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction xs arbitrary: x y rule: sorted_wrt.induct)
  case (1 x xs)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases "x = y")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      by simp
  next
    case False
    then have "x \<noteq> y" by simp
    then have "index (x # xs) x = 0" "index (x # xs) y = Suc (index xs y)"
      by (auto simp: index_Cons)
    then have "index (x # xs) x < index (x # xs) y \<longleftrightarrow> index xs y < 1"
      by simp
    also have "\<dots> \<longleftrightarrow> (y, x) \<notin> R"
      using "1.prems" "1.IH" by (auto simp: sorted_wrt_Cons)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
next
  case (2 x y xs)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases "x = y")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      by simp
  next
    case False
    then have "x \<noteq> y" by simp
    then have "index (y # x # xs) x = Suc (index (x # xs) x)"
      "index (y # x # xs) y = 0"
      by (auto simp: index_Cons)
    then have "index (y # x # xs) x < index (y # x # xs) y \<longleftrightarrow> index (x # xs) x < 1"
      by simp
    also have "\<dots> \<longleftrightarrow> (y, x) \<notin> R"
      using "2.prems" "2.IH" by (auto simp: sorted_wrt_Cons)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
qed

      using snoc.prems by (intro snoc.IH) (auto simp: set_rev)

      by (simp add: linorder_of_list_def)
    ultimately show ?thesis
      by (rule linorder_on_Un) (auto simp: set_rev)

  thus ?case by (simp add: set_rev)

lemma linorder_sorted_wrt_exists:
  assumes "linorder_on A R" "finite B" "B \<subseteq> A"
  shows   "\<exists>xs. set xs = B \<and> distinct xs \<and> sorted_wrt R xs"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction rule: finite_subset_induct[OF assms(2,3)])
  case (insert x B)
  from insert.IH obtain xs where "set xs = B" "distinct xs" "sorted_wrt R xs"
    by auto
  with insert.prems have "sorted_wrt R xs" "x \<in> A" "x \<notin> set xs"
    by (auto simp: linorder_on_def)
  with \<open>linorder_on A R\<close> have "sorted_wrt R (xs @ [x])"
    by (auto intro: sorted_wrt_append)
  with \<open>set xs = B\<close> \<open>x \<notin> set xs\<close> show ?case
    by (auto intro!: exI[of _ "xs @ [x]"] simp: distinct_append)
qed (auto intro!: exI[of _ "[]"])

end

lemma sorted_wrt_list_of_set_eqI:
  assumes "linorder_on B R" "A \<subseteq> B" "set xs = A" "distinct xs" "sorted_wrt R xs"
  shows   "sorted_wrt_list_of_set R A = xs"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction xs rule: list_of_set_induct)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by (simp add: sorted_wrt_list_of_set_def)
next
  case (insert x A)
  have "sorted_wrt_list_of_set R (insert x A) = sorted_wrt_list_of_set R A @ [x]"
    using insert.prems by (simp add: sorted_wrt_list_of_set_def)
  also have "sorted_wrt_list_of_set R A = A"
    using insert.prems by (intro sorted_wrt_list_of_set_eqI) auto
  also have "A @ [x] = [x]"
    using insert.prems by (auto simp: sorted_wrt_list_of_set_def)
  finally show ?case by simp
qed

lemma linorder_rank_le: 
  assumes "finite A"
  shows   "linorder_rank R A x \<le> card A"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction A arbitrary: x rule: measure_induct_rule[of "card"])
  case (1 A x)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "A = {}")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by (simp add: linorder_rank_def)
  next
    case False
    then obtain a A' where A: "A = insert a A'" "a \<notin> A'" by (meson finite_imp_in_finite)
    then have "card A = Suc (card A')" by (simp add: card_insert_disjoint)
    then have "card A' < card A" by simp
    then have "linorder_rank R A' x \<le> card A'" by (rule 1)
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "R x a")
      case True
      then have "linorder_rank R A x = Suc (linorder_rank R A' x)"
        by (simp add: A linorder_rank_def)
      then show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case False
      then have "linorder_rank R A x = linorder_rank R A' x"
        by (simp add: A linorder_rank_def)
      then show ?thesis by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

theorem bij_betw_linorder_of_list:
  assumes "finite A"
  shows   "bij_betw linorder_of_list (permutations_of_set A) {R. linorder_on A R}"
trg:
using assms
proof (rule bij_betwI[where ?g = "linorder_of_list_inv A"])
  fix R assume R: "R \<in> {R. linorder_on A R}"
  have "linorder_of_list (linorder_of_list_inv A R) = R"
    using R by (auto simp: linorder_of_list_inv_def)
  with R show "linorder_of_list (linorder_of_list_inv A R) = R" by simp
next
  fix xs assume "xs \<in> permutations_of_set A"
  thus "linorder_of_list (linorder_of_list_inv A (linorder_of_list xs)) = linorder_of_list xs"
    by (simp add: linorder_of_list_inv_def)
next
  fix R assume R: "R \<in> {R. linorder_on A R}"
  have "linorder_of_list_inv A (linorder_of_list (linorder_of_list_inv A R)) = R"
    using R by (auto simp: linorder_of_list_inv_def)
  with R show "linorder_of_list_inv A (linorder_of_list (linorder_of_list_inv A R)) = R" by simp
next
  fix xs assume "xs \<in> permutations_of_set A"
  thus "linorder_of_list_inv A (linorder_of_list xs) \<in> {R. linorder_on A R}"
    by (auto simp: linorder_of_list_inv_def)
qed (auto simp: linorder_of_list_inv_def permutations_of_set_def)

lemma almost_full_on_Plus:
  assumes "almost_full_on P A" and "almost_full_on Q B"
  shows "almost_full_on (sum_le P Q) (A <+> B)" (is "almost_full_on ?P ?A")
trg:
using assms
proof (rule almost_full_on_subset)
  show "?P = sum_le P Q" by (simp add: sum_le_def)
  show "?A = A <+> B" by (simp add: sum_set_def)
  show "almost_full_on (sum_le P Q) (A <+> B)"
  proof (rule almost_full_onI)
    fix f :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a + 'b"
    assume "inj_on f UNIV"
    then obtain fA fB where "inj_on fA UNIV" "inj_on fB UNIV"
      and f: "f = (\<lambda>n. case fA n of Inl a \<Rightarrow> Inl (fst a) | Inr b \<Rightarrow> Inr (snd b))"
      and fA: "fA ` UNIV = A" and fB: "fB ` UNIV = B"
      by (rule sum_inj_onE)
    from assms obtain aA aB where "aA \<in> A" "aB \<in> B"
      and aA: "almost_full_on P (fA -` {aA})"
      and aB: "almost_full_on Q (fB -` {aB})"
      by (auto simp: almost_full_on_def)
    have "almost_full_on (sum_le P Q) (f -` {Inl aA, Inr aB})"
      by (rule almost_full_on_UnI[OF aA aB]) (auto simp: f fA fB)
    then show "almost_full_on (sum_le P Q) (f ` UNIV)"
      by (intro almost_full_on_subset) (auto simp: f fA fB)
  qed
qed

lemma list_emb_eq_length_P:
  assumes "length xs = length ys"
    and "list_emb P xs ys"
  shows "\<forall>i<length xs. P (xs ! i) (ys ! i)"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction rule: list_emb.induct)
  case (Cons xs ys x y)
  then have "length xs = length ys"
    by simp
  then have "length (tl xs) = length (tl ys)"
    by simp
  then have "list_emb P (tl xs) (tl ys)"
    using Cons.prems(2) by simp
  then have "\<forall>i<length (tl xs). P (tl xs ! i) (tl ys ! i)"
    using Cons.IH by simp
  then have "\<forall>i<length xs - 1. P (tl xs ! i) (tl ys ! i)"
    by simp
  then have "\<forall>i<length xs - 1. P (xs ! Suc i) (ys ! Suc i)"
    by simp
  then have "\<forall>i<length xs - 1. P (xs ! i) (ys ! i)"
    by simp
  then have "\<forall>i<length xs. P (xs ! i) (ys ! i)"
    using Cons.prems(1) by (metis One_nat_def Suc_lessI Suc_pred length_greater_0_conv nth_Cons_Suc)
  then show ?case
    by simp
qed simp

lemma LEX_imp_less:
  assumes "\<forall>x\<in>A. \<not> P x x" and "f \<in> SEQ A \<or> g \<in> SEQ A"
    and "LEX P f g" and "\<forall>i<k. f i = g i" and "f k \<noteq> g k"
  shows "P (f k) (g k)"
trg:
using assms
proof (prove)
  assume 1: "\<forall>x\<in>A. \<not> P x x"
  assume 2: "f \<in> SEQ A \<or> g \<in> SEQ A"
  assume 3: "LEX P f g"
  assume 4: "\<forall>i<k. f i = g i"
  assume 5: "f k \<noteq> g k"

  show "P (f k) (g k)"
    using 6 by (metis 1 5)
qed

  shows "T\<^sub>p [x,y] qs (OPT2 qs [x,y]) = ((length qs - 2) / 2)"

proof (prove)
  assume a1: "x \<noteq> y"
  assume a2: "qs \<in> lang (seq[Atom x, Atom y, Atom x, Star(Times (Atom y) (Atom x)), Atom x])"
  have f3: "T\<^sub>p [x, y] qs (OPT2 qs [x, y]) = T\<^sub>p [x, y] qs (OPT1 qs [x, y])"
    by (metis OPT1_OPT2_eq)

    by (metis OPT1_OPT2_eq)
  have f6: "T\<^sub>p [x, y] qs (OPT2 qs [y, x]) = T\<^sub>p [x, y] qs (OPT2 qs [x, y])"
    by (metis OPT2_sym)

lemma potential:
fixes t :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a::linordered_ab_group_add" and p :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a"
assumes p0: "p 0 = 0" and ppos: "\<And>n. p n \<ge> 0"
and ub: "\<And>n. t n + p(n+1) - p n \<le> u n"
shows "(\<Sum>i<n. t i) \<le> (\<Sum>i<n. u i)"
trg:
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  have "(\<Sum>i<Suc n. t i) = (\<Sum>i<n. t i) + t n" by (simp add: sum.lessThan_Suc)
  also have "... \<le> (\<Sum>i<n. u i) + t n" using Suc by simp
  also have "... \<le> (\<Sum>i<n. u i) + u n" using ub[of n] by (simp add: ppos)
  also have "... = (\<Sum>i<Suc n. u i)" by (simp add: sum.lessThan_Suc)
  finally show ?case .
qed

using assms

    by (auto simp: T_on'.simps)
next
  case (snoc a as)
  have "qs = as @ [a]" by (simp add: snoc.prems)
  then have "T_on' (rTS h0) ([x, y], h) qs = T_on' (rTS h0) ([x, y], h) as + T_on' (rTS h0) ([x, y], h) [a]"
    by (simp add: T_on'.simps)
  also have "T_on' (rTS h0) ([x, y], h) [a] = 2"
    using assms(1) by (auto simp: T_on'.simps)

  also have "2 * T\<^sub>p [x, y] as (OPT2 as [x, y]) + 2 = 2 * (T\<^sub>p [x, y] as (OPT2 as [x, y]) + 1)"

    using assms(1) by (auto simp: T_on'.simps)
  finally have "T_on' (rTS h0) ([x, y], h) qs = 2 * T\<^sub>p [x, y] (as @ [a]) (OPT2 (as @ [a]) [x, y])"

    by (auto simp: T_on'.simps)
qed

lemma count_take_less: assumes "n\<le>m" 
  shows "count_list (take n cs) x \<le> count_list (take m cs) x"

using assms proof (induction cs arbitrary: n m)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a cs)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases "n=0")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by simp
  next
    case False
    then have "n > 0" by simp
    then obtain n' where n': "n = Suc n'" by (metis Suc_pred)
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "m=0")
      case True
      then show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case False
      then obtain m' where m': "m = Suc m'" by (metis Suc_pred)
      then show ?thesis
      proof (cases "x=a")
        case True
        then show ?thesis
          by (simp add: n' m' count_list.simps(2))
      next
        case False
        then show ?thesis
          by (simp add: n' m' count_list.simps(2) Cons.IH)
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma bit_yx: assumes "x \<noteq> y" 
      and kas: "init \<in> {[x,y],[y,x]}"
      and "qs \<in> lang (Star(Times (Atom y) (Atom x))) "
   shows "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT (type1 init x y) (qs@r) = 0.75 * length qs + T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT (type1 init x y) r 
    \<and> config'_rand BIT (type1 init x y) qs  = (type1 init x y)"

lemma bit_yxyx: assumes "x \<noteq> y" and kas: "init \<in> {[x,y],[y,x]}" and
      "qs \<in> lang (seq[Times (Atom y) (Atom x), Star(Times (Atom y) (Atom x))])"
   shows "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT (type0 init x y) (qs@r) = 0.75 * length qs + T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT (type1 init x y) r 
    \<and> config'_rand BIT (type0 init x y) qs  = (type1 init x y)"

lemma BIT_x: assumes "x\<noteq>y"
       "init \<in> {[x,y],[y,x]}" "qs \<in> lang (Plus (Atom x) One)"
 shows "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT (type0 init x y) (qs@r) = T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT (type0 init x y) r 
    \<and> config'_rand BIT  (type0 init x y) qs = (type0 init x y)"
trg:
using assms proof (induct qs arbitrary: r)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by (simp add: BIT_def)
next
  case (Cons a qs)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases a)
    case (Atom a')
    then show ?thesis
    proof (cases "a' = x")
      case True
      then show ?thesis
        using Cons.prems by (simp add: BIT_def)
    next
      case False
      then show ?thesis
        using Cons.prems Atom by (simp add: BIT_def)
    qed
  next
    case One
    then show ?thesis
      using Cons.prems by (simp add: BIT_def)
  qed
qed

end

   "qs \<in> lang (seq [Plus (Atom x) One, Atom y, Atom y])"
  shows "config'_rand BIT (type0 init x y) qs = (type0 init y x)" (is ?C)
    and b: "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT (type0 init x y) qs = 1.5" (is ?T)

using assms proof (prove)
  have "init = [x, y] \<or> init = [y, x]" using assms(2) by auto
  then show ?C ?T
  proof (cases "init = [x, y]")
    case True
    then show ?C ?T
      using assms(1,3)
      by (simp add: BIT_def config'_rand_append T\<^sub>p_on_rand'_append)
  next
    case False
    then have "init = [y, x]" using assms(2) by auto
    then show ?C ?T
      using assms(1,3)
      by (simp add: BIT_def config'_rand_append T\<^sub>p_on_rand'_append)
  qed
qed

    "set qs \<subseteq> {a, b}"
 shows "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT s qs \<le> 175 / 10\<^sup>2 * real (T\<^sub>p [a, b] qs (OPT2 qs [a, b])) \<and>
    BIT_inv (Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT s qs) (last qs) [x, y]"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction qs arbitrary: s rule: rev_induct)
  case Nil
  then show ?case
    by (simp add: BIT_inv_def)
next
  case (snoc q qs)
  have "set qs \<subseteq> {a, b}" "set (qs @ [q]) \<subseteq> {a, b}"
    using snoc.prems by auto
  then have "qs \<in> Lxx a b"
    using Lxx_append_in by blast
  then have "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT s qs \<le> 175 / 10\<^sup>2 * real (T\<^sub>p [a, b] qs (OPT2 qs [a, b])) \<and>
    BIT_inv (Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT s qs) (last qs) [x, y]"
    using snoc.prems(1-4) by (rule snoc.IH)
  then have "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT s qs \<le> 175 / 10\<^sup>2 * real (T\<^sub>p [a, b] qs (OPT2 qs [a, b]))"
    and "BIT_inv (Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT s qs) (last qs) [x, y]"
    by auto
  then have "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT (Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT s qs) [q] \<le> 175 / 10\<^sup>2 * real (T\<^sub>p [a, b] [q] (OPT2 [q] [a, b]))"
    and "BIT_inv (Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT (Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT s qs) [q]) q [x, y]"
    using BIT_inv_step[of "last qs" "Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT s qs" "s" "a" "b" "x" "y" "q"]
    by (auto simp add: BIT_inv_def)
  then have "T\<^sub>p_on_rand' BIT s (qs @ [q]) \<le> 175 / 10\<^sup>2 * real (T\<^sub>p [a, b] (qs @ [q]) (OPT2 (qs @ [q]) [a, b]))"
    and "BIT_inv (Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT s (qs @ [q])) (last (qs @ [q])) [x, y]"
    using BIT_inv_step[of "last qs" "Partial_Cost_Model.config'_rand BIT s qs" "s" "a" "b" "x" "y" "q"]
    by (auto simp add: BIT_inv_def)
  then show ?case
    by (simp add: BIT_inv_def)
qed

lemma numberofIsbeschr: assumes
    distxsys: "dist_perm xs ys" and
    yinxs: "y \<in> set xs"
  shows "index xs y \<le> index ys y + card (InvOf y xs ys)" 
    (is "?iBit \<le> ?iA + card ?I")
trg:
using distxsys yinxs
proof (prove)
  have "?iA + card ?I = index ys y + card (InvOf y xs ys)" by simp
  also have "... = index ys y + card {i. i < length xs \<and> xs ! i = y}"
    by (simp add: InvOf_def)
  also have "... = index ys y + card {i. i < length xs \<and> xs ! i = y \<and> ys ! i = y}"
    by (simp add: dist_perm_def)
  also have "... = index ys y + card {i. i < length xs \<and> xs ! i = y \<and> ys ! i = y \<and> i = index xs y}"
    by (simp add: index_def)
  also have "... = index ys y + card {index xs y}"
    by (simp add: index_def)
  also have "... = index ys y + 1"
    by (simp add: index_def)
  also have "... = index xs y"
    by (simp add: index_def)
  finally show "?iBit \<le> ?iA + card ?I" by simp
qed

end

lemma factoringlemma_withconstant:
    fixes A
          and b::real
          and c::real
      assumes c: "c \<ge> 1"
      assumes dist: "\<forall>e\<in>S0. distinct e"
      assumes notempty: "\<forall>e\<in>S0. length e > 0"
      (* A has pairwise property *)
      assumes pw: "pairwise A"
      (* A is c-competitive on list of length 2 *) 
      assumes on2: "\<forall>s0\<in>S0. \<exists>b\<ge>0. \<forall>qs\<in>{x. set x \<subseteq> set s0}. \<forall>(x,y)\<in>{(x,y). x \<in> set s0 \<and> y\<in>set s0 \<and> x<y}. T\<^sub>p_on_rand A (Lxy s0 {x,y}) (Lxy qs {x,y})  \<le> c * (T\<^sub>p_opt (Lxy s0 {x,y}) (Lxy qs {x,y})) + b" 
      assumes nopaid: "\<And>is s q. \<forall>((free,paid),_) \<in> (snd A (s, is) q). paid=[]"
      assumes 4: "\<And>init qs. distinct init \<Longrightarrow> set qs \<subseteq> set init \<Longrightarrow> (\<And>x. x<length qs \<Longrightarrow> finite (set_pmf (config'' A qs init x)))" 
      (* then A is c-competitive on arbitrary list lengths *)
      shows "\<forall>s0\<in>S0. \<exists>b\<ge>0.  \<forall>qs\<in>{x. set x \<subseteq> set s0}. 
              T\<^sub>p_on_rand A s0 qs \<le> c * real (T\<^sub>p_opt s0 qs) + b"

  by (metis (no_types, lifting) factoringlemma_withconstant)

lemma ex_bij_betw_strict_mono_card:
  assumes "finite M" "M \<subseteq> ON"
  obtains h where "bij_betw h {..<card M} M" and "strict_mono_on h {..<card M}"
trg:
using assms proof (induction M rule: finite_induct)
  case empty
  then show ?case
    by (intro that[of id]) (auto simp: bij_betw_def strict_mono_on_def)
next
  case (insert x M)
  then have "x \<in> ON" "M \<subseteq> ON" "finite M" by auto
  obtain h where h: "bij_betw h {..<card M} M" "strict_mono_on h {..<card M}"
    using insert.IH[OF \<open>finite M\<close> \<open>M \<subseteq> ON\<close>] by auto
  define h' where "h' n = (if n = card M then x else h n)" for n
  have "bij_betw h' {..<card (insert x M)} (insert x M)"
  proof (rule bij_betw_byWitness[of _ "h' (the_inv_into {..<card (insert x M)} h' x)"])
    show "h' ` {..<card (insert x M)} = insert x M"
      using h' by (auto simp: bij_betw_def)
    show "the_inv_into {..<card (insert x M)} h' x \<in> {..<card (insert x M)}"
      using h' by (auto simp: bij_betw_def)
    show "h' (the_inv_into {..<card (insert x M)} h' x) = x"
      using h' by (auto simp: bij_betw_def)
    show "h' ` {..<card M} = M"
      using h' by (auto simp: bij_betw_def)
    show "inj_on h' {..<card (insert x M)}"
      using h' by (auto simp: inj_on_def)
  qed
  moreover have "strict_mono_on h' {..<card (insert x M)}"
  proof (clarsimp simp: strict_mono_on_def)
    fix i j assume "i < card (insert x M)" "j < card (insert x M)" "i < j"
    then consider "i < card M" "j < card M" | "i = card M" "j = card M"
      by (cases "i = card M" "j = card M" rule: bool.exhaust[case_product bool.exhaust]) auto
    then show "h' i < h' j"
    proof cases
      case 1
      then show ?thesis using h by (auto simp: strict_mono_on_def)
    next
      case 2
      then show ?thesis using h' by (auto simp: strict_mono_on_def)
    qed
  qed
  ultimately show ?case by (rule that)
qed
end

trg:
using assms
proof (prove)
  assume "P \<sim>\<cdot> Q"
  assume "bn \<alpha> \<sharp>* Q"
  assume "P \<rightarrow> \<langle>\<alpha>,P'\<rangle>"
  then obtain P'' where "P = P'' \<and> P' = P''[<\<alpha>>]"
    by (metis transition_form)
  then have "P'' \<sim>\<cdot> Q"
    using assms(1) by simp
  then obtain Q'' where "Q \<rightarrow> \<langle>\<alpha>,Q''\<rangle>" and "P'' \<sim>\<cdot> Q''"
    using assms(2) by (metis bisimilar_simulation)
  then have "P' \<sim>\<cdot> Q''[<\<alpha>>]"
    using `P' = P''[<\<alpha>>]` by simp
  then show ?thesis
    using `Q \<rightarrow> \<langle>\<alpha>,Q''\<rangle>` by blast
qed

((a \<rightleftharpoons> b) \<bullet> t2) =\<^sub>\<alpha> t2 \<Longrightarrow> P ((a \<rightleftharpoons> b) \<bullet> t2) t2) \<Longrightarrow>

lemma formula_induct [case_names Conj Not Pred Act, induct type: formula]:
  fixes x
  assumes "\<And>xset. finite (supp xset) \<Longrightarrow> (\<And>x. x \<in> set_bset xset \<Longrightarrow> P x) \<Longrightarrow> P (Conj xset)"
    and "\<And>formula. P formula \<Longrightarrow> P (Not formula)"

  shows "P x"

lemma alpha_Tree_induct[case_names tConj tNot tPred tAct, consumes 1]:
  assumes "t1 =\<^sub>\<alpha> t2"
  and "\<And>tset1 tset2. (\<And>a b. a \<in> set_bset tset1 \<Longrightarrow> b \<in> set_bset tset2 \<Longrightarrow> a =\<^sub>\<alpha> b \<Longrightarrow> P a b) \<Longrightarrow>
            rel_bset (=\<^sub>\<alpha>) tset1 tset2 \<Longrightarrow> P (tConj tset1) (tConj tset2)"
  and "\<And>t1 t2. t1 =\<^sub>\<alpha> t2 \<Longrightarrow> P t1 t2 \<Longrightarrow> P (tNot t1) (tNot t2)"
  and "\<And>f \<phi>. P (tPred f \<phi>) (tPred f \<phi>)"
  and "\<And>f1 \<alpha>1 t1 f2 \<alpha>2 t2. (\<And>p. p \<bullet> t1 =\<^sub>\<alpha> t2 \<Longrightarrow> P (p \<bullet> t1) t2) \<Longrightarrow> f1 = f2 \<Longrightarrow>
            (\<exists>p. (bn \<alpha>1, t1) \<approx>set (=\<^sub>\<alpha>) (supp_rel (=\<^sub>\<alpha>)) p (bn \<alpha>2, t2) \<and> (bn \<alpha>1, \<alpha>1) \<approx>set (=) supp p (bn \<alpha>2, \<alpha>2)) \<Longrightarrow>
            P (tAct f1 \<alpha>1 t1) (tAct f2 \<alpha>2 t2)"
  shows "P t1 t2"
trg:
using assms(1) proof (induction rule: alpha_Tree_induct)
  case (tConj tset1 tset2)
  then show ?case
    by (metis (no_types, lifting) assms(2) rel_bset.rep_eq)
next
  case (tNot t1 t2)
  then show ?case
    by (metis (no_types, lifting) assms(3) alpha_Tree_eqvt)
next
  case (tPred f \<phi>)
  then show ?case
    by (metis (no_types, lifting) assms(4))
next
  case (tAct f1 \<alpha>1 t1 f2 \<alpha>2 t2)
  then show ?case
    by (metis (no_types, lifting) assms(5) alpha_Tree_eqvt)
qed

end

  assumes h: "\<And>n :: nat. current \<Gamma> (h n)"
  and SAT: "\<And>n. (B \<Gamma> \<inter> \<^bold>V) - {b} \<subseteq> SAT \<Gamma> (h n)"
  and b: "b \<in> B \<Gamma>"
  and IN: "(SUP n. d_IN (h n) b) = weight \<Gamma> b"
  and h0_b: "\<And>n. d_IN (h 0) b \<le> d_IN (h n) b"
  and b_V: "b \<in> \<^bold>V"

proof (rule ccontr)
  assume "\<not> (\<exists>h'. current \<Gamma> h' \<and> wave \<Gamma> h' \<and> B \<Gamma> \<inter> \<^bold>V \<subseteq> SAT \<Gamma> h')"
  then obtain h' where h': "current \<Gamma> h'" "wave \<Gamma> h'" "B \<Gamma> \<inter> \<^bold>V \<subseteq> SAT \<Gamma> h'"
    by blast
  have "d_OUT h' b = 0"
  proof (rule antisym)
    show "d_OUT h' b \<le> 0"
      using h'(3) b b_V by (auto simp: SAT.simps)
    show "0 \<le> d_OUT h' b"
      using h'(1) b by (auto simp: currentD_OUT)
  qed
  then have "d_OUT h' b = 0"
    by simp
  then have "d_IN h' b = 0"
    using h'(1) b by (auto simp: currentD_IN)
  then have "d_IN (h' + h) b = d_IN h' b + d_IN h 0"
    using b_V by (auto simp: currentD_IN)
  also have "\<dots> = d_IN h 0"
    using h'(1) b by (auto simp: currentD_IN)
  also have "\<dots> = weight \<Gamma> b"
    using IN by (auto simp: currentD_IN)
  finally have "d_IN (h' + h) b = weight \<Gamma> b" .
  moreover have "current \<Gamma> (h' + h)"
    using h h' by (auto simp: current_add)
  ultimately show False
    using h'(3) b b_V by (auto simp: SAT.simps)
qed

lemma lim_h_plus_OUT_IN:

  shows "d_OUT lim_h_plus x = d_IN lim_h_plus x"
trg:
proof -
  have "d_OUT lim_h_plus x = d_OUT (h_plus x) x"
    by (simp add: lim_h_plus_def)
  also have "\<dots> = d_IN (h_plus x) x"
  proof (rule d_OUT_eq_d_IN)
    show "h_plus x x = 0"
      by (simp add: h_plus_def)
  next
    show "x \<noteq> source \<Delta>"
      by fact
  next
    show "x \<noteq> sink \<Delta>"
      by fact
  qed
  also have "\<dots> = d_IN lim_h_plus x"
    by (simp add: lim_h_plus_def)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

end

lemma d_IN_lift_Inner [simp]:
  assumes "x \<noteq> source \<Delta>"
  shows "d_IN (lift f) (Inner x) = d_IN f x" (is "?lhs = ?rhs")
trg:
proof -
  have "?lhs = (\<Sum>\<^sup>+ y. f (x, y) + f (y, x))"
    unfolding d_IN_def by (auto simp: nn_integral_add nn_integral_count_space_indicator)
  also have "\<dots> = ?rhs"
    by (simp add: nn_integral_add nn_integral_count_space_indicator)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

end

src: lemma d_IN_lift_source [simp]: "d_IN (lift f) (Inner (source \<Delta>)) = value_flow \<Delta> f + d_IN f (source \<Delta>)" (is "?lhs = ?rhs")
trg:
proof -
  have "?lhs = (\<Sum>\<^sup>+ x. f x * ennreal (weight \<Delta> x)) + d_IN f (source \<Delta>)"
    unfolding d_IN_def by (subst nn_integral_add) (auto simp: nn_integral_mult_right_ennreal)
  also have "\<dots> = ?rhs"
    by (simp add: value_flow_def)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

end

  finally show ?thesis .

lemma wave_not_RF_IN_zero:

  assumes f: "current \<Gamma> f"
  and w: "wave \<Gamma> f"
  and x: "x \<notin> RF (TER f)"
  shows "d_IN f x = 0"

proof -
  have "d_IN f x = 0"
  proof (rule antisym)
    show "d_IN f x \<le> 0"
      using f x by(rule d_IN_le_0)

    have "d_OUT f x = 0"

    with f have "d_IN f x = d_OUT f x"

    thus "0 \<le> d_IN f x" by simp
  qed
  thus ?thesis by simp
qed

end

lemma currentD_OUT':
  assumes f: "current \<Gamma> f"
  and x: "x \<notin> A \<Gamma>"
  shows "d_OUT f x = 0"
trg:
proof -
  have "d_OUT f x = (\<Sum>\<^sup>+ y\<in>range (fst x). f (x, y))"
    by (simp add: d_OUT_def)
  also have "\<dots> = (\<Sum>\<^sup>+ y\<in>range (fst x). 0)"
    using f x by (intro nn_integral_cong) (auto simp: currentD_outside)
  also have "\<dots> = 0"
    by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

end

lemma currentD_IN':
  assumes f: "current \<Gamma> f"
  and x: "x \<notin> B \<Gamma>"
  shows "d_IN f x = 0"
trg:
proof -
  have "d_IN f x = (\<Sum>\<^sup>+ y\<in>range f. f (x, y))"
    unfolding d_IN_def by simp
  also have "\<dots> = 0"
  proof (rule nn_integral_0_iff_AE[THEN iffD2])
    show "(\<lambda>y. f (x, y)) \<in> borel_measurable (count_space (range f))"
      by (auto simp: f)
  next
    show "AE y in count_space (range f). f (x, y) = 0"
    proof (rule AE_I)
      show "{y \<in> range f. f (x, y) \<noteq> 0} \<subseteq> {}" by simp
      show "emeasure (count_space (range f)) {} = 0" by simp
    qed
  qed
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

end

lemma (in group) pq_order_unique_subgrp:
  assumes finite:"finite (carrier G)"
  assumes orderG:"order G = q * p"
  assumes primep:"prime p" and primeq:"prime q" and pq:"p < q"
  shows "\<exists>!Q. Q \<in> (subgroups_of_size q)"
trg:
proof (rule ex_ex1I)
  show "\<exists>Q. Q \<in> subgroups_of_size q"
  proof (rule bexI)
    show "subgroup Q G"
      using Q_def by (simp add: Q_def subgroup_of_size_q)
    show "order Q = q"
      using Q_def by (simp add: Q_def order_of_subgroup)
  qed
next
  fix Q Q'
  assume Q:"Q \<in> subgroups_of_size q" and Q':"Q' \<in> subgroups_of_size q"
  have "Q = Q'"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "Q \<noteq> Q'"
    then have "Q <#> Q' = G"
      using Q Q' by (simp add: Q_def Q'_def)
    then have "order (Q <#> Q') = order G"
      using order_mult by simp
    then have "order (Q <#> Q') = q * p"
      using orderG by simp
    then have "order (Q <#> Q') = order Q * order Q'"
      using Q Q' by (simp add: Q_def Q'_def)
    then have "q * p = q * q"
      using Q Q' by (simp add: Q_def Q'_def)
    then have "p = q"
      using primep primeq by (simp add: prime_dvd_mult_eq_nat)
    then show False
      using pq by simp
  qed
  then show "Q = Q'" by simp
qed

lemma bernoulli_inequality: assumes x: "-1 \<le> (x :: 'a :: linordered_field)"
  shows "1 + of_nat n * x \<le> (1 + x) ^ n"
trg:
proof (induct n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  assume "1 + of_nat n * x \<le> (1 + x) ^ n"
  then have "1 + of_nat n * x + x \<le> (1 + x) ^ n + x"
    by (rule add_right_mono)
  then have "1 + of_nat n * x + x \<le> (1 + x) * (1 + x) ^ n"
    by (simp add: right_distrib)
  then have "1 + of_nat n * x + x \<le> (1 + x) ^ Suc n"
    by (simp add: power_commutes)
  then show "1 + of_nat (Suc n) * x \<le> (1 + x) ^ Suc n"
    by (simp add: add.commute mult.commute)
qed

end

lemma prime_elem_dvd_prod_list:
  assumes p: "prime_elem p" and pA: "p dvd prod_list A" shows "\<exists>a \<in> set A. p dvd a"
trg:
using pA
proof (induction A)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a A)
  then show ?case
  proof (cases "p dvd a")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by blast
  next
    case False
    then have "p dvd prod_list A" using Cons.prems by simp
    then have "\<exists>a\<in>set A. p dvd a" using Cons.IH by blast
    then show ?thesis by blast
  qed
qed

end

lemma prime_elem_dvd_prod_mset:
  assumes p: "prime_elem p" and pA: "p dvd prod_mset A" shows "\<exists>a \<in># A. p dvd a"
trg:
using pA
proof (induction A)
  case empty
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (add a A)
  then have "p dvd a * prod_mset A" by simp
  then consider (p_dvd_a) "p dvd a" | (p_dvd_prod) "p dvd prod_mset A"
    using prime_elem_dvd_multD[OF p] by blast
  then show ?case
  proof cases
    case p_dvd_a
    then show ?thesis by (auto intro: p_dvd_a)
  next
    case p_dvd_prod
    then obtain b where "b \<in># A" "p dvd b" using add.IH by blast
    then show ?thesis by (auto intro: p_dvd_b)
  qed
qed

end

  then obtain d where "1 = a * d" by (elim dvdE, auto)
  thus "(a * b) dvd c \<longleftrightarrow> b dvd c"
  proof (rule iffI)
    assume "(a * b) dvd c"
    then obtain e where "c = a * b * e" by (elim dvdE, auto)
    hence "c = a * (b * e)" by (simp add: ac_simps)
    thus "b dvd c" by (rule dvdI[of "b * e"], simp)
  next
    assume "b dvd c"
    then obtain e where "c = b * e" by (elim dvdE, auto)
    hence "c = a * (d * (b * e))" by (simp add: `1 = a * d` ac_simps)
    thus "(a * b) dvd c" by (rule dvdI[of "d * (b * e)"], simp)
  qed
qed

lemma neville_aitken: assumes "\<And> i j. i < j \<Longrightarrow> j \<le> n \<Longrightarrow> x i \<noteq> x j"
  shows "j \<le> n \<Longrightarrow> poly (neville_aitken x f n) (x j) = (f j)"
trg:
proof (induction n arbitrary: j)
  case 0
  then show ?case by (auto simp: neville_aitken_def)
next
  case (Suc n)
  have "j \<le> Suc n" by fact
  then consider "j = Suc n" | "j \<le> n" by linarith
  then show ?case proof cases
    case 1
    then show ?thesis by (auto simp: neville_aitken_def)
  next
    case 2
    have "poly (neville_aitken x f (Suc n)) (x j) =
      poly (neville_aitken x f n) (x j) -
      (x j - x n) * poly (neville_aitken x f n) (x n) / (x j - x n)"
      by (simp add: neville_aitken_def)
    also have "\<dots> = f j - (x j - x n) * f n / (x j - x n)"
      by (simp add: Suc.IH[OF 2])
    also have "\<dots> = f j"
      using assms[of n j] 2 by auto
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
qed

end

  shows "sum_list (map (\<lambda> j. xij_f i (i + j) * pprod k i (i + j)) [0..<Suc k - i]) = 
  sum_list (map (\<lambda> j. xij_f (Suc i) (Suc i + j) * pprod k (Suc i) (Suc i + j)) [0..<Suc k - Suc i])"

  case (Suc k)
  have "sum_list (map (\<lambda>j. xij_f i (i + j) * pprod (Suc k) i (i + j)) [0..<Suc (Suc k) - i]) =
    sum_list (map (\<lambda>j. xij_f i (i + j) * pprod k i (i + j)) [0..<Suc k - i]) +
    xij_f i (i + (Suc k - i)) * pprod k i (i + (Suc k - i))"
    by (simp add: sum_list_append)
  also have "... = sum_list (map (\<lambda>j. xij_f (Suc i) (Suc i + j) * pprod k (Suc i) (Suc i + j)) [0..<Suc k - Suc i]) +
    xij_f i (Suc (i + (k - i))) * pprod k i (Suc (i + (k - i)))"
    by (simp add: Suc.IH)
  also have "... = sum_list (map (\<lambda>j. xij_f (Suc i) (Suc i + j) * pprod k (Suc i) (Suc i + j)) [0..<Suc (Suc k) - Suc i])"
    by (simp add: Suc.prems(2))

lemma newton_poly_sound: assumes "k \<le> n"
  shows "poly (newton_poly n) (x k) = f k"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction n arbitrary: k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by (auto simp: newton_poly_def)
next
  case (Suc n)
  have "poly (newton_poly (Suc n)) (x k) = poly (newton_poly n) (x k) * (x k - x n) + poly (newton_poly n) (x n) * (x k - x n)"
    by (simp add: newton_poly_def poly_mult poly_add poly_diff)
  also have "poly (newton_poly n) (x k) = f k"
    by (rule Suc.IH[OF Suc.prems])
  also have "poly (newton_poly n) (x n) = f n"
    by (rule Suc.IH[OF Suc.prems])
  also have "poly (newton_poly n) (x k) * (x k - x n) + poly (newton_poly n) (x n) * (x k - x n) = f k * (x k - x n) + f n * (x k - x n)"
    by simp
  also have "f k * (x k - x n) + f n * (x k - x n) = f k"
    by (simp add: f_def)
  finally show ?case by simp
qed

end

    by (simp add: poly_eq_0_iff_dvd)

  with `degree p > 0` have "x = 0" by simp
  with x show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma poly_prod_0: "finite ps \<Longrightarrow> poly (prod f ps) x = (0 :: 'a :: field) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists> p \<in> ps. poly (f p) x = 0)"
trg:
proof (induct rule: finite_induct)
  case (insert p ps)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "poly (f p) x = 0")
    case True
    then show ?thesis by auto
  next
    case False
    have "poly (prod f (insert p ps)) x = 0 \<longleftrightarrow> poly (f p) x * poly (prod f ps) x = 0"
      by (simp add: prod.insert)
    also have "\<dots> \<longleftrightarrow> poly (prod f ps) x = 0"
      using False by auto
    also have "\<dots> \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>q\<in>ps. poly (f q) x = 0)"
      using insert by auto

    finally show ?thesis .

lemma poly_eqI2:
  assumes "degree p = degree q" and "\<And>i. i \<le> degree p \<Longrightarrow> coeff p i = coeff q i"

proof (prove)
  using assms(1)
  proof (induct "degree p" arbitrary: p q rule: less_induct)
    case (less n)
    show ?case
    proof (cases "n = 0")
      case True
      then have "p = 0" "q = 0"
        using less(2) by (auto simp: degree_0)
      then show ?thesis by simp

      case False

      then have "degree (p - q) < n"

    qed

lemma degree_prod_monic: 
  assumes "\<And> i. i < n \<Longrightarrow> degree (f i :: 'a :: comm_semiring_1 poly) = 1"
    and "\<And> i. i < n \<Longrightarrow> coeff (f i) 1 = 1"
  shows "degree (prod f {0 ..< n}) = n \<and> coeff (prod f {0 ..< n}) n = 1"
trg:
proof (induct n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  have "degree (f n * prod f {0..<n}) = degree (f n) + degree (prod f {0..<n})"
    by (simp add: degree_mult_eq)
  also have "degree (f n) = 1" using Suc(2) by simp
  also have "degree (prod f {0..<n}) = n" using Suc(1) Suc(2) by simp
  finally have "degree (f n * prod f {0..<n}) = 1 + n" by simp
  moreover have "coeff (f n * prod f {0..<n}) (Suc n) = coeff (f n) 1 * coeff (prod f {0..<n}) n"
    by (simp add: coeff_mult)
  also have "coeff (f n) 1 = 1" using Suc(2) by simp
  also have "coeff (prod f {0..<n}) n = 1" using Suc(1) Suc(2) by simp
  finally have "coeff (f n * prod f {0..<n}) (Suc n) = 1" by simp
  ultimately show ?case by simp
qed

end

  shows "degree (p ^ n) = degree (p :: 'a :: idom poly) * n"

  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "n = 0")
    case True
    with p show ?thesis by (simp add: degree_monom_eq)
  next
    case False
    then have "degree (p ^ n) = degree (p ^ n) * degree p"
      by (metis Suc.hyps degree_power_eq p)
    also have "... = degree (p ^ n) * degree p + degree p"
      by simp
    also have "... = degree (p ^ n * p)"
      by (metis degree_mult_eq p)
    also have "... = degree (p ^ Suc n)"
      by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
qed

end

    then have "degree b = 0"
      by simp

lemma irreducible_monic_factor: fixes p :: "'a :: field poly" 
  assumes "degree p > 0" 
  shows "\<exists> q r. irreducible q \<and> p = q * r \<and> monic q"
trg:
using assms
proof (induct "degree p" arbitrary: p rule: less_induct)
  case (less p)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "degree p = 1")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      by (metis degree_1_imp_monic irreducible_monic_linear_factor)
  next
    case False
    then have "degree p > 1" using less.prems by auto
    then obtain q r where "p = q * r" "degree q < degree p" "degree r < degree p"
      using poly_decompose_degree_lt[of p] by auto
    then have "degree q > 0" "degree r > 0" using less.prems by auto
    then obtain q' r' where "irreducible q'" "q = q' * q'" "monic q'"
      and "irreducible r'" "r = r' * r'" "monic r'"
      using less.hyps[of q] less.hyps[of r] by auto
    then have "irreducible (q' * r')" "p = q' * r' * (q' * r')" "monic (q' * r')"
      by (auto simp: mult_ac)
    then show ?thesis by blast
  qed
qed
end

lemma listToFuns_ext:
  assumes xs: "set xs = UNIV"
  assumes d: "distinct xs"
  shows "g \<in> set (listToFuns f xs) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>x. g x \<in> set (f x))"
trg:
using assms
proof (prove)
  show "g \<in> set (listToFuns f xs) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>x. g x \<in> set (f x))"
  proof (cases "g \<in> set (listToFuns f xs)")
    case True
    then obtain i where "g = fst (listToFuns f xs ! i)" "i < length (listToFuns f xs)"
      by auto
    then have "g x = fst (listToFuns f xs ! i) x" for x
      by simp
    then have "g x \<in> set (f x)" for x
      using listToFuns_nth[OF xs d, of i x] by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using True by auto
  next
    case False
    then have "g \<notin> set (listToFuns f xs)"
      by simp
    then have "g x \<notin> set (f x)" for x
      using listToFuns_set[OF xs d] by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using False by auto
  qed
qed

end

lemma distinct_sorted_induct [consumes 2, case_names Nil insert]:
  assumes "distinct xs"
  assumes "sorted xs"
  assumes base: "P []"
  assumes step: "\<And>x xs. \<lbrakk> distinct (x # xs); sorted (x # xs); P xs \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> P (x # xs)"
  shows "P xs"
trg:
using assms proof (induction xs rule: rev_induct)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by (simp add: base)
next
  case (snoc x xs)
  then have "distinct xs" "sorted xs" "P xs" by simp_all
  then have "P (x # xs)" by (rule step)
  then show ?case by simp
qed

end

lemma MapOpsI[intro]:
  "\<lbrakk> \<And>k. \<alpha> k \<in> d \<Longrightarrow> lookup ops (empty ops) k = None;
     \<And>e k k' M. \<lbrakk> \<alpha> k \<in> d; \<alpha> k' \<in> d \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
                 lookup ops (update ops k e M) k'
              = (if \<alpha> k' = \<alpha> k then Some e else lookup ops M k') \<rbrakk>
     \<Longrightarrow> MapOps \<alpha> d ops"

lemma MapOps_emptyD:
  "\<lbrakk> \<alpha> k \<in> d; MapOps \<alpha> d ops \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> lookup ops (empty ops) k = None"

lemma MapOps_lookup_updateD:
  "\<lbrakk> \<alpha> k \<in> d; \<alpha> k' \<in> d; MapOps \<alpha> d ops \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> lookup ops (update ops k e M) k' = (if \<alpha> k' = \<alpha> k then Some e else lookup ops M k')"

lemma isSome_simps[simp]:
  "\<And>x. isSome (Some x)"
  "\<And>x. \<not> isSome x \<longleftrightarrow> x = None"

lemma isSome_eq:
  "isSome x \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>y. x = Some y)"
lemma isSomeE: "\<lbrakk> isSome x; \<And>s. x = Some s \<Longrightarrow> Q \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> Q"

lemma envObs_def_raw:
  "envObs a = (\<lambda>s. (envObsC (es s), ODList.lookup (ps s) a))"

src:
lemma tObsC_tLength:
  "tObsC t = tObsC t' \<Longrightarrow> tLength t = tLength t'"

lemma tObsC_tStep_eq_inv:
  "tObsC t' = tObsC (t \<leadsto> s) \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>t'' s'. t' = t'' \<leadsto> s'"

lemma tObsC_prefix_closed[dest]:
  "tObsC (t \<leadsto> s) = tObsC (t' \<leadsto> s') \<Longrightarrow> tObsC t = tObsC t'"

lemma tObsC_tLast[iff]:
  "tLast (tObsC t) = envObsC (es (tLast t))"

lemma tObsC_initial[iff]:
  "tFirst (tObsC t) = envObsC (es (tFirst t))"
  "tObsC (tInit s) = tInit (envObsC (es s))"
  "tObsC t = tInit cobs \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>s. t = tInit s \<and> envObsC (es s) = cobs)"

lemma spr_tObsC_trc_aux:
  assumes "(t, t') \<in> (\<Union>a. relations SPR.MC a)\<^sup>*"
  shows "tObsC t = tObsC t'"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction rule: rtrancl_induct)
  case (step t t'')
  then have "tObsC t = tObsC t'" by (metis SPR.MC.simps)
  then show ?case using step by (metis rtrancl_into_rtrancl)
qed (simp)

  "tObsC t' = tObsC t

lemma tObsC_absI[intro]:

  "spr_knowledge envObs cec = (\<lambda>a s.
     ODList.fromList [ s' . s' \<leftarrow> toList cec,
                               envObs a (fst s) = envObs a (fst s') \<and> envObs a (snd s) = envObs a (snd s') ])"

lemma (in -) [code]:
  "spr_commonKnowledge envObs cec = (\<lambda>as s.
    let r = \<lambda>a. ODList.fromList
               [ (s', s'') . s' \<leftarrow> toList cec, s'' \<leftarrow> toList cec,
                             envObs a (fst s') = envObs a (fst s'') \<and> envObs a (snd s') = envObs a (snd s'') ];
        R = toList (ODList.big_union r as)
     in ODList.fromList (memo_list_trancl R s))"

lemma spr_knowledge:
  "s \<in> toSet cec
    \<Longrightarrow> toSet (spr_knowledge envObs cec a s) = relations (spr_repMC (toSet cec)) a `` {s}"

lemma spr_commonKnowledge_relation_image:
  "s \<in> toSet cec
    \<Longrightarrow> toSet (spr_commonKnowledge envObs cec as s) = (\<Union>a \<in> set as. relations (spr_repMC (toSet cec)) a)\<^sup>+ `` {s}"

     \<longleftrightarrow> spr_repMC (toSet Y), s \<Turnstile> \<phi>"
trg:
using XY s
proof (prove)
using this:
toSet X \<subseteq> toSet Y
s \<in> toSet X

goal (1 subgoal):
 1. s \<in> toSet (eval_rec (spr_evalProp envVal) (spr_knowledge envObs Y) (spr_commonKnowledge envObs Y) X \<phi>) = spr_repMC (toSet Y), s \<Turnstile> \<phi>
  by (metis (no_types) assms(1) assms(2) eval_rec_models_aux)

using tC jkbpSynDet jkbpSemDet
by (auto simp: jAction_def jAction_det_def)

theorem dnf_eval : 
  "(\<exists>(al,fl)\<in>set (dnf \<phi>). 
     (\<forall>a\<in>set al. aEval a xs) 
   \<and> (\<forall>f\<in>set fl. eval f xs))
   = eval \<phi> xs"

theorem dnf_modified_eval : 
  "(\<exists>(al,fl,n)\<in>set (dnf_modified \<phi>).
      (\<exists>L. (length L = n 
       \<and> (\<forall>a\<in>set al. aEval a (L@xs))
       \<and> (\<forall>f\<in>set fl. eval f (L@xs))))) = eval \<phi> xs"

    then (\<forall>m\<in>monomials p. lookup m x = 0)
    else (\<exists>m\<in>monomials p. lookup m x = k) \<and> (\<forall>m\<in>monomials p. lookup m x \<le> k))"

lemma lookup_eq_and_update_lemma: "lookup m var = deg \<and> Poly_Mapping.update var 0 m = x \<longleftrightarrow>

lemma degree_one : "MPoly_Type.degree (Var x :: real mpoly) x = 1"

lemma coeff_isolate_variable_sparse:
  "MPoly_Type.coeff (isolate_variable_sparse p var deg) x =
  (if lookup x var = 0

  else 0)"

theorem QE_dnf_eval: 
  assumes steph : "\<And>var amount new L F \<Gamma>.
  amount\<le>var+1 \<Longrightarrow>
    (\<exists>xs. (length xs = var+1 \<and> eval (list_conj (map fm.Atom L @ F)) (xs @ \<Gamma>))) = (\<exists>xs. (length xs = var+1 \<and>eval (step amount var L F) (xs @ \<Gamma>)))"
  assumes opt : "\<And>xs F . eval (opt F) xs = eval F xs"
  shows "eval (QE_dnf opt step \<phi>) xs = eval \<phi> xs"
trg:
proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. eval (QE_dnf opt step \<phi>) xs = eval \<phi> xs
[PROOF STATE]
proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. eval (QE_dnf opt step \<phi>) xs = eval \<phi> xs
[PROOF STEP]
using assms
[PROOF STATE]
proof (prove)
using this:
amount\<le>var+1 \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>xs. length xs = var+1 \<and> eval (list_conj (map fm.Atom L @ F)) (xs @ \<Gamma>) = (\<exists>xs. length xs = var+1 \<and> eval (step amount var L F) (xs @ \<Gamma>))
eval (opt F) xs = eval F xs

goal (1 subgoal):
 1. eval (QE_dnf opt step \<phi>) xs = eval \<phi> xs
[PROOF STEP]
by (induction \<phi> arbitrary: xs) (auto simp add: steph opt)

lemma HOinitConfig_eq:
  "HOinitConfig A cfg = (\<forall>p. initState A p (cfg p))"

lemma SHOnextConfig_eq:
  "SHOnextConfig A r cfg HO SHO cfg' =
   (\<forall>p. \<exists>\<mu> \<in> SHOmsgVectors A r p cfg (HO p) (SHO p).
             nextState A r p (cfg p) \<mu> (cfg' p))"

lemma SHORun_eq:
  "SHORun A rho HOs SHOs =
     (HOinitConfig A (rho 0)
   \<and> (\<forall>r. SHOnextConfig A r (rho r) (HOs r) (SHOs r) (rho (Suc r))))"

lemma SHOmsgVectors_HO:
  "SHOmsgVectors A r p cfg HO HO = {HOrcvdMsgs A r p HO cfg}"

lemma CHOnextConfig_eq:
  "CHOnextConfig A r cfg HO coord cfg' =
   (\<forall>p. CnextState A r p (cfg p) (HOrcvdMsgs A r p (HO p) cfg) 
                   (coord p) (cfg' p))"

lemma CHORun_eq:
  "CHORun A rho HOs coords = 
     (CHOinitConfig A (rho 0) (coords 0)
      \<and> (\<forall>r. CHOnextConfig A r (rho r) (HOs r) (coords (Suc r)) (rho (Suc r))))"
trg:
<proof>

lemma HOnextConfig_eq:

   (\<forall>p. nextState A r p (cfg p) (HOrcvdMsgs A r p (HO p) cfg) (cfg' p))"

lemma CHORun_0:
  assumes "CHORun A rho HOs coords" 
      and "\<And>cfg. CHOinitConfig A cfg (coords 0) \<Longrightarrow> P cfg"
  shows "P (rho 0)"

lemma CHORun_Suc:
  assumes "CHORun A rho HOs coords"
  and "\<And>r. CHOnextConfig A r (rho r) (HOs r) (coords (Suc r)) (rho (Suc r))
            \<Longrightarrow> P r"
  shows "P n"
trg:
using assms(1) proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case
    by (metis (no_types, lifting) assms(2) CHORun.cases CHORun.simps(2) CHOnextConfig.simps(2) Suc_eq_plus1)
qed

end

lemma CHORun_induct:
  assumes run: "CHORun A rho HOs coords"
  and init: "CHOinitConfig A (rho 0) (coords 0) \<Longrightarrow> P 0"
  and step: "\<And>r. \<lbrakk> P r; CHOnextConfig A r (rho r) (HOs r) (coords (Suc r)) 
                                      (rho (Suc r)) \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> P (Suc r)"
  shows "P n"
trg:
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  with init show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  with step[of n] show ?case by simp
qed

end

  shows "P \<approx> Q"
trg:
proof (prove)
using this:
(P, Q) \<in> X
\<lbrakk>(?P, ?Q) \<in> X; (?Q, ?P) \<notin> X\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> ?P \<leadsto>\<^sup>^<(X \<union> weakBisim)> ?Q
\<lbrakk>(?P, ?Q) \<in> X; (?Q, ?P) \<notin> X\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> (?Q, ?P) \<in> X \<or> ?Q \<approx> ?P

goal (1 subgoal):

by (coinduction arbitrary: P Q rule: weakBisimCoinduct) (auto intro: step)
end
