  fixes P  :: pi
  and   P' :: pi
  and   F  :: "'a::fs_name \<Rightarrow> pi \<Rightarrow> pi \<Rightarrow> bool"
  and   C  :: "'a::fs_name"

  assumes Trans:  "P \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> P'"
  and     "\<And>P C. F C (\<tau>.(P)) P"
  and     "\<And>P P' a C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> P'; \<And>C. F C P P'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C ([a\<frown>a]P) P'"
  and     "\<And>P P' a b C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> P'; \<And>C. F C P P'; a \<noteq> b\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C ([a\<noteq>b]P) P'"
  and     "\<And>P P' Q C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> P'; \<And>C. F C P P'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<oplus> Q) P'"
  and     "\<And>Q Q' P C. \<lbrakk>Q \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> Q'; \<And>C. F C Q Q'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<oplus> Q) Q'"
  and     "\<And>P P' Q C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> P'; \<And>C. F C P P'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<parallel> Q) (P' \<parallel> Q)"
  and     "\<And>Q Q' P C. \<lbrakk>Q \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> Q'; \<And>C. F C Q Q'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<parallel> Q) (P \<parallel> Q')"
  and     "\<And>P a b P' Q Q' C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>a<b> \<prec> P'; Q \<longmapsto>OutputR a b \<prec> Q'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<parallel> Q) (P' \<parallel> Q')"
  and     "\<And>P a b P' Q Q' C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>OutputR a b \<prec> P'; Q \<longmapsto>a<b> \<prec> Q'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<parallel> Q) (P' \<parallel> Q')"
  and     "\<And>P a x P' Q Q' C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>a<x> \<prec> P'; Q \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> Q'; x \<sharp> P; x \<sharp> Q; x \<noteq> a; x \<sharp> C\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<parallel> Q) (<\<nu>x>(P' \<parallel> Q'))"
  and     "\<And>P a x P' Q Q' C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P'; Q \<longmapsto>a<x> \<prec> Q'; x \<sharp> P; x \<sharp> Q; x \<noteq> a; x \<sharp> C\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<parallel> Q) (<\<nu>x>(P' \<parallel> Q'))"
  and     "\<And>P P' x C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> P'; x \<sharp> C; \<And>C. F C P P'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
                        F C (<\<nu>x>P) (<\<nu>x>P')"
  and     "\<And>P P' C. \<lbrakk>P \<parallel> !P \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> P'; \<And>C. F C (P \<parallel> !P) P'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (!P) P'"

  shows "F C P P'"

using assms
proof (prove)

  assume "P \<longmapsto>\<tau> \<prec> P'"

  proof(nominal_induct rule: tau.strong_induct)

  next
    case(Match P a b P' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Mismatch P a b P' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Sum1 P Q C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Sum2 P Q C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Par1 P Q P' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Par2 P Q Q' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Comm1 P Q P' Q' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Comm2 P Q P' Q' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Close1 P Q P' Q' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Close2 P Q P' Q' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Res P P' x C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  next
    case(Bang P P' C)
    then show ?case by(blast intro: tauInduct)
  qed
qed

  and     cComm2: "\<And>a b P' P'' C. \<lbrakk>P \<longmapsto> (OutputR a b) \<prec> P'; !P \<longmapsto> a<b> \<prec> P''; \<And>C. F C (!P) (a<b> \<prec> P'')\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>

  and     cPar2F: "\<And>\<alpha> P' C. \<lbrakk>!P \<longmapsto> \<alpha> \<prec> P'; \<And>C. F C (!P) (\<alpha> \<prec> P')\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> F C (P \<parallel> !P) (\<alpha> \<prec> P \<parallel> P')"

lemma bangPres:
  fixes P :: pi
  and   Q :: pi

  assumes PBiSimQ: "P \<sim> Q"

  shows "!P \<sim> !Q"
trg:
proof -
  have "!P \<leadsto>[bangRel] !Q"
  proof(induct rule: simCases)
    case(cSim a x P' Q')
    from `Q \<longmapsto> a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P'` `P \<sim> Q`
    obtain P'' where "P \<longmapsto> a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P''" and "P'' \<sim> P'"
      by(blast dest: bisimE)
    from `P \<longmapsto> a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P''` have "!P \<longmapsto> a<\<nu>x> \<prec> !P''"
      by(rule Bang)
    moreover from `P'' \<sim> P'` have "!P'' \<sim> !P'"
      by(rule bangPres)
    ultimately show ?case by blast
  next
    case(cSym a x P' Q')
    from `P \<sim> Q` have "Q \<sim> P" by(rule bisimE)
    with `Q \<longmapsto> a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P'` obtain Q'' where "Q \<longmapsto> a<\<nu>x> \<prec> Q''" and "Q'' \<sim> P'"
      by(blast dest: bisimE)
    from `Q \<longmapsto> a<\<nu>x> \<prec> Q''` have "!Q \<longmapsto> a<\<nu>x> \<prec> !Q''"
      by(rule Bang)
    moreover from `Q'' \<sim> P'` have "!Q'' \<sim> !P'"
      by(rule bangPres)
    ultimately show ?case by blast
  qed
  thus ?thesis by(blast intro: bangRel.Bang)
qed

lemma expandComplete:
  fixes F :: "pi set"

  assumes "finite F"

  shows "\<exists>P. (P, F) \<in> sumComposeSet"
trg:
using assms proof (induct F)
  case empty
  show ?case
    by (rule exI[of _ "[]"], simp add: sumComposeSet_def)
next
  case (insert x F)
  from `finite F` have "F \<subseteq> F" by simp
  from `\<exists>P. (P, F) \<in> sumComposeSet` obtain P where "(P, F) \<in> sumComposeSet" by blast
  from `x \<in> F` have "x \<in> F" by simp
  from `finite F` have "finite F" by simp
  from `(P, F) \<in> sumComposeSet` `x \<in> F` `finite F` have "\<exists>P'. (P', F) \<in> sumComposeSet \<and> x \<in> set P'"
    by (rule sumComposeSet_insert)
  then obtain P' where "(P', F) \<in> sumComposeSet" and "x \<in> set P'" by blast
  from `(P', F) \<in> sumComposeSet` have "x \<sharp> P'" by (rule sumComposeSet_fresh)
  from `x \<in> set P'` `x \<sharp> P'` have "x # P' \<in> sumComposeSet" by (rule sumComposeSet_cons)
  then show ?case by (rule exI)
qed

end

lemma parCompose:

  and   Q     :: pi
  and   R     :: pi
  and   T     :: pi
  and   Rel   :: "(pi \<times> pi) set"

  and   Rel'' :: "(pi \<times> pi) set"
  
  assumes PSimQ:    "P \<leadsto>[Rel] Q"
  and     RSimT:    "R \<leadsto>[Rel'] S"
  and     PRelQ:    "(P, Q) \<in> Rel"
  and     RRel'T:   "(R, S) \<in> Rel'"
  and     Par:      "\<And>P' Q' R' S'. \<lbrakk>(P', Q') \<in> Rel; (R', S') \<in> Rel'\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> (P' \<parallel> R', Q' \<parallel> S') \<in> Rel''"
  and     Res:      "\<And>S T x. (S, T) \<in> Rel'' \<Longrightarrow> (<\<nu>x>S, <\<nu>x>T) \<in> Rel''"

  shows "P \<parallel> R \<leadsto>[Rel''] Q \<parallel> S"
trg:
proof -
  have "P \<parallel> R \<leadsto>[Rel''] Q \<parallel> S"
  proof(induct rule: simCases)
    case(Sim a x)
    from `(a{x} \<prec> Q \<parallel> S)`
    show ?case
    proof(induct rule: parCases)
      case(cPar1 P' Q')
      from `(P', Q') \<in> Rel` `(R, S) \<in> Rel'`
      have "(P' \<parallel> R, Q' \<parallel> S) \<in> Rel''" by(rule Par)
      thus ?case by blast
    next
      case(cPar2 R' S')
      from `(P, Q) \<in> Rel` `(R', S') \<in> Rel'`
      have "(P \<parallel> R', Q \<parallel> S') \<in> Rel''" by(rule Par)
      thus ?case by blast
    qed
  next
    case(Free a x)
    from `x \<sharp> P \<parallel> R` `x \<sharp> Q \<parallel> S`
    have "x \<sharp> P" and "x \<sharp> R" and "x \<sharp> Q" and "x \<sharp> S" by simp+
    from `x \<sharp> P` `P \<leadsto>[Rel] Q`
    obtain P' where "P \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P'" and "derivative P' Q' a x Rel"
      by(blast dest: simE)
    from `x \<sharp> R` `R \<leadsto>[Rel'] S`
    obtain R' where "R \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> R'" and "derivative R' S' a x Rel'"
      by(blast dest: simE)
    from `P \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P'` `R \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> R'`
    have "P \<parallel> R \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> (P' \<parallel> R')" by(rule Par1)
    moreover from `derivative P' Q' a x Rel` `derivative R' S' a x Rel'`
    have "derivative (P' \<parallel> R') (Q' \<parallel> S') a x Rel''" by(rule derivativePar)
    ultimately show ?case by blast

    case(Tau)

    proof(induct rule: parCases)

      have "(P' \<parallel> R, Q' \<parallel> S) \<in> Rel''" by(rule Par)
      thus ?case by blast
    next
      case(cPar2 R' S')
      from `(P, Q) \<in> Rel` `(R', S') \<in> Rel'`
      have "(P \<parallel> R', Q \<parallel> S') \<in> Rel''" by(rule Par)
      thus ?case by blast
    qed
  next
    case(Res a x Q' S')
    from `x \<sharp> P \<parallel> R` `x \<sharp> Q'` `x \<sharp> S'`
    have "x \<sharp> P" and "x \<sharp> R" and "x \<sharp> Q'" and "x \<sharp> S'" by simp+
    from `x \<sharp> P` `P \<leadsto>[Rel] Q`
    obtain P' where "P \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P'" and "derivative P' Q' a x Rel"
      by(blast dest: simE)
    from `x \<sharp> R` `R \<leadsto>[Rel'] S`
    obtain R' where "R \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> R'" and "derivative R' S' a x Rel'"
      by(blast dest: simE)
    from `P \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> P'` `R \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> R'`
    have "P \<parallel> R \<longmapsto>a<\<nu>x> \<prec> (P' \<parallel> R')" by(rule Par1)
    moreover from `derivative P' Q' a x Rel` `derivative R' S' a x Rel'`
    have "derivative (P' \<parallel> R') (Q' \<parallel> S') a x Rel''" by(rule derivativePar)
    ultimately show ?case by blast
  qed
  thus ?thesis by blast
qed

src: lemma DirProds_comm_group_iff: "comm_group (DirProds G I) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>i\<in>I. comm_group (G i))"
trg:
proof (prove)
  show "comm_group (DirProds G I) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>i\<in>I. comm_group (G i))"
  proof (intro iffI allI impI)
    assume "comm_group (DirProds G I)"
    then interpret G: comm_group "DirProds G I" .
    fix i
    assume "i \<in> I"
    then have "G i = DirProds G {i}"
      by (auto simp: DirProds_singleton)
    then show "comm_group (G i)"
      by (auto intro: G.subgroup_comm_groupI subgroup_DirProds)
  next
    assume "\<forall>i\<in>I. comm_group (G i)"
    then have "subgroup (G i) (DirProds G I)" if "i \<in> I" for i
      using that by (auto simp: DirProds_singleton intro: subgroup_DirProds)
    then have "subgroup (DirProds G I) (DirProds G I)"
      by (auto intro: subgroup_DirProds)
    then have "comm_group (DirProds G I)"
      by (auto intro: comm_groupI)
    then show "comm_group (DirProds G I)" .
  qed
qed

lemma DirProds_finite_imp_finite_groups:
  assumes "finite_group (DirProds G I)" "finite I"
  shows "\<And>i. i\<in>I \<Longrightarrow> finite_group (G i)"
trg:
using assms
proof (induct I rule: finite_induct)
  case empty
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (insert i I)
  interpret DirProds: group "DirProds G (insert i I)"
    using DirProds_group[OF _ _ insert.prems(2)] by simp
  have "i\<in>insert i I" by simp
  have "DirProds G (insert i I) = DirProds (G i) I \<times>\<^sub>G G i"
    using DirProds_insert[OF _ _ insert.prems(2)] by simp
  then have "finite_group (DirProds (G i) I \<times>\<^sub>G G i)"
    using DirProds.group_axioms by simp
  then have "finite_group (G i) \<and> finite_group (DirProds (G i) I)"
    using DirProds_finite_imp_finite_groups[OF _ insert.prems(2)] by simp
  then show ?case using insert.hyps(1) by simp
qed

end

lemma DirProds_finite_group_iff:
  assumes "finite I"
  shows "finite_group (DirProds G I) \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>i\<in>I. finite_group (G i))"
trg:
using assms
proof (induct rule: finite_induct)
  case empty
  then show ?case
    by (simp add: DirProds_empty)
next
  case (insert i I)
  have "finite_group (DirProds G (insert i I)) \<longleftrightarrow>
        finite_group (G i \<times>\<^sub>G DirProds G I)"
    by (simp add: DirProds_insert)
  also have "\<dots> \<longleftrightarrow> finite_group (G i) \<and> finite_group (DirProds G I)"
    by (rule finite_group_times_group)
  also have "\<dots> \<longleftrightarrow> finite_group (G i) \<and> (\<forall>i\<in>I. finite_group (G i))"
    using insert.hyps by simp
  also have "\<dots> \<longleftrightarrow> (\<forall>i\<in>insert i I. finite_group (G i))"
    by simp
  finally show ?case .
qed

end

lemma DirProds_iso:
  assumes "bij_betw f I J" "\<And>i. i\<in>I \<Longrightarrow> Gs i \<cong> Hs (f i)"
          "\<And>i. i\<in>I \<Longrightarrow> group (Gs i)" "\<And>j. j\<in>J \<Longrightarrow> group (Hs j)"
  shows "DirProds Gs I \<cong> DirProds Hs J"
trg: by (rule iso_DirProdsI[OF assms(1)]) (auto simp: assms(2) iso_def bij_betw_def)

lemma DirProds_iso1:
  assumes "\<And>i. i\<in>I \<Longrightarrow> Gs i \<cong> (f \<circ> Gs) i" "\<And>i. i\<in>I \<Longrightarrow> group (Gs i)" "\<And>i. i\<in>I \<Longrightarrow> group ((f \<circ> Gs) i)"
  shows "DirProds Gs I \<cong> DirProds (f \<circ> Gs) I"
trg:
proof (rule iso_set_DirProds)
  show "(\<lambda>i. SOME h. h \<in> iso (Gs i) ((f \<circ> Gs) i)) i \<in> iso (Gs i) ((f \<circ> Gs) i)"
    if "i \<in> I" for i
    using that by (metis (no_types, lifting) assms(1) someI_ex)
  show "group (Gs i)" if "i \<in> I" for i
    using that assms(2) by blast
  show "group ((f \<circ> Gs) i)" if "i \<in> I" for i
    using that assms(3) by blast
qed

end

lemma (in group) set_mult_card_le:
  assumes "finite H" "H \<subseteq> carrier G" "J \<subseteq> carrier G"
  shows "card (H <#> J) \<le> card H * card J"
trg:
using assms
proof (induct H)
  case empty
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (insert x H)
  have "card (insert x H <#> J) = card (H <#> J) + card (x <#> J)"
    using set_mult_assoc[of x H J] insert.prems by (simp add: set_mult_subset_eq)
  also have "card (H <#> J) \<le> card H * card J" using insert.hyps by simp
  also have "card (x <#> J) \<le> card J" using set_mult_subset_eq[of x J] insert.prems by simp
  finally show ?case by simp
qed

  assumes "finite S" "\<And>a. a \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> f a \<noteq> 0"

  case empty

    by auto
  finally show ?case .

lemma pairwise_coprime_dvd:
  assumes "finite A" "pairwise coprime A" "(n::nat) = prod id A" "\<forall>a\<in>A. a dvd j"
  shows "n dvd j"
trg:
using assms
proof (induction A rule: finite_induct)
  case empty
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (insert a A)
  have "coprime a (prod id A)"
    using insert.prems(2) by (auto intro: pairwise_coprimeI)
  then have "coprime a (j div prod id A)"
    using insert.prems(4) by (auto intro: coprime_dvd_mult_right)
  then have "a dvd j div prod id A"
    using coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff by blast
  then have "a * (j div prod id A) = j"
    using insert.prems(4) by (auto simp: mult.commute)
  then show ?case
    using insert.prems(1) by (auto simp: prod.insert)
qed

lemma pairwise_coprime_dvd':
  assumes "finite A" "\<And>i j. \<lbrakk>i \<in> A; j \<in> A; i \<noteq> j\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> coprime (f i) (f j)"
          "(n::nat) = prod f A" "\<forall>a\<in>A. f a dvd j"
  shows "n dvd j"
trg:
proof (prove)
  using assms(1,4)
proof (induction A rule: finite_induct)
  case empty
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (insert x A)
  have "f x dvd j" "prod f A dvd j" using insert.prems by auto
  then have "gcd (f x) (prod f A) dvd j" by (metis gcd_dvd1 gcd_dvd2)
  moreover have "coprime (f x) (prod f A)"
    using insert.prems(2) by (auto intro!: coprime_prod_rightI)
  ultimately have "f x * prod f A dvd j"
    by (metis coprime_dvd_mult_right_iff)
  then show ?case using insert.hyps by simp
qed

end

lemma of_int_divide_in_Ints_iff:
  assumes "b \<noteq> 0"
  shows   "(of_int a / of_int b :: 'a :: field_char_0) \<in> \<int> \<longleftrightarrow> b dvd a"
trg:
using assms
proof (rule iffI)
  assume "(of_int a / of_int b :: 'a) \<in> \<int>"
  then obtain c where "of_int a / of_int b = of_int c" by (elim Ints_cases)
  hence "of_int a = of_int b * of_int c" by (simp add: field_simps)
  thus "b dvd a" by (metis of_int_eq_iff)
next
  assume "b dvd a"
  then obtain c where "a = b * c" by (elim dvdE)
  hence "of_int a = of_int b * of_int c" by simp
  hence "of_int a / of_int b = of_int c" by (simp add: field_simps)
  thus "(of_int a / of_int b :: 'a) \<in> \<int>" by (rule Ints_of_int)
qed

end

lemma (in comm_group) idirprod_generate_ind:
  assumes "finite gs" "gs \<subseteq> carrier G" "g \<in> carrier G"

          "complementary (generate G {g}) (generate G gs)"

      "is_idirprod (generate G F) (\<lambda>g. generate G {g}) F"
      "complementary (generate G {g}) (generate G F)"

  then show ?case
    using insert.prems by (simp add: is_idirprod_def)
qed

lemma (in comm_group) finite_sub_card_eq_mult_imp_comp:
  assumes "subgroup H G" "subgroup J G" "finite H" "finite J"
  and "card (H <#> J) = (card J * card H)"
  shows "complementary H J"
trg:

proof (prove)
  have "H \<inter> J = {one G}"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "H \<inter> J \<noteq> {one G}"
    then obtain x where "x \<in> H \<inter> J" "x \<noteq> one G" by blast
    then have "x \<in> H" "x \<in> J" by auto

  qed
  then show ?thesis by (auto simp: complementary_def)
qed

lemma (in group) IDirProd_empty_right:
  assumes "A \<subseteq> carrier G"
  shows "IDirProd G A {} = generate G A"
trg:
proof (unfold IDirProd_def, rule equalityI)
  show "generate G A \<subseteq> {x. \<exists>a\<in>A. x = a} \<inter> {x. \<forall>a\<in>A. x \\<cdot> a = x}"
    by (auto simp add: generate_def)
next
  show "{x. \<exists>a\<in>A. x = a} \<inter> {x. \<forall>a\<in>A. x \\<cdot> a = x} \<subseteq> generate G A"
  proof (rule subsetI)
    fix x assume "x \<in> {x. \<exists>a\<in>A. x = a} \<inter> {x. \<forall>a\<in>A. x \\<cdot> a = x}"
    then have "x \<in> {x. \<exists>a\<in>A. x = a}" and "x \<in> {x. \<forall>a\<in>A. x \\<cdot> a = x}" by auto
    then obtain a where "a \<in> A" and "x = a" by auto
    then have "x \<in> generate G A" by (auto simp add: generate_def)
    then show "x \<in> generate G A" by simp
  qed
qed

end

proof (induction A rule: infinite_finite_induct)
  case (infinite A)

  case (insert x A)

    case True
    then show ?thesis

    case False
    have "generate G (\<Union> {generate G {x} |x. x \<in> f (insert x A)}) = generate G (f A \<union> generate G {x})"
      by (metis (no_types, lifting) Union_Un_distrib image_Un insert.hyps(1) insert.hyps(2) insert.prems(1) insert_is_Un)

      by (metis False assms(1) generate_Un insert.hyps(1) insert.hyps(2) insert.prems(1) insert_is_Un)
    also have "... = generate G (f (insert x A))"
      by (metis False assms(1) generate_Un insert.hyps(1) insert.hyps(2) insert.prems(1) insert_is_Un)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  then show ?case
    by simp
qed

    by (metis One_nat_def of_nat_1 of_nat_mod)
  then show "get_exp a a mod ord a = 1 mod ord a"
    by (metis get_exp_def)
